punch.Name: Bare Fists
punch.Description: Strike with your bare hands. Weak, but better than nothing. Find a weapon.

slash.Name: Slash
slash.Description: Your weapon's basic attack, no mana cost. Quick cuts at the enemy in front of you, three in a row.

strike.Name: Cleave
strike.Description: Cleave through every enemy in a wide arc in front of you. Your greatsword's mana skill; Slash is its free attack.

arcane_bolt.Name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.Description: Your staff's basic attack, no mana cost. A fast bolt of violet arcane force that strikes the first enemy in its path.

zap.Name: Zap
zap.Description: A spell: lightning strikes the enemy from the sky, then chains to {Chains} more, a tenth less on each jump. Your staff's mana skill; Arcane Bolt is its free attack. (The Lightning and Added Lightning supports put lightning on your other skills.)

ground_slam.Name: Ground Slam
ground_slam.Description: Slam the ground: a shockwave of dust and cracking earth bursts out in a cone in front of you, damaging every enemy it reaches and staggering those it hits hard.

leap_slam.Name: Leap Slam
leap_slam.Description: Leap through the air to the target location and crash down, damaging enemies where you land.

ember_bolt.Name: Ember Bolt
ember_bolt.Description: Hurl a ball of fire that explodes on impact, burning every enemy in the blast.

frost_nova.Name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.Description: Release a ring of frost around you, damaging and chilling every nearby enemy.

arc.Name: Chain Lightning
arc.Description: Lightning leaps from your hand to the enemy you aim at (or the nearest one), then chains between up to {Chains} more, a tenth less on each jump.

move.Name: Move
move.Description: Walk towards the cursor, ignoring enemies, items and the portal. Put it on a key as a force move: Left Click still walks and fights.

vow_of_clarity.Name: Vow of Clarity
vow_of_clarity.Description: Swear a Vow of clear thought: you regenerate mana. Reserves a small, flat amount of mana while sworn (it fits an early mana pool). Press again to break it (Vowbreak): for 4 seconds your skills cost no mana, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds and you are Forsworn.

vow_of_vigor.Name: Vow of Vigor
vow_of_vigor.Description: Swear a Vow of the living body: you regenerate life, and your attacks gain a little mana on hit. Reserves 16% of your mana while sworn. Vowbreak: heal a quarter of your life at once and regenerate far faster for 4 seconds.

woe_of_withering.Name: Woe of Withering
woe_of_withering.Description: Lay a Woe on every enemy in an area: they take 30% more Poison damage and move 15% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it: the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread (+3% Woe effect per Dread, up to 20). An enemy that dies under it spreads the Woe to 2 nearby enemies. Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

toll_of_dread.Name: Toll of Dread
toll_of_dread.Description: Ring the toll: every Woe in an area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, 10% more per Dread it carried.

death_sentence.Name: Death Sentence
death_sentence.Description: Sentence one enemy: it takes 22% more damage from everything. Only one enemy can be Sentenced; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (28.6% more damage taken).

jarls_roar.Name: Jarl's Roar
jarls_roar.Description: A war cry of the old jarls: enemies around you turn on you, and you gain a Resolve charge for each enemy it reaches (up to 3). Resolve: 6% reduced physical damage taken and +6% to elemental resistances per charge.

war_banner_skill.Name: War Banner
war_banner_skill.Description: Plant your War Banner where you aim (up to 8 metres away); use it again to move it. Enemies within 6 metres of the banner (further with Area of Effect: area supports and increased area reach it, counted each time you plant or move the banner) take 6% more damage. Every enemy that dies near it adds a Valour (+0.5% more, up to 20); a Rare, Unique or Guardian fighting near it adds one every 2 seconds. Moving the banner keeps half its Valour. Walk away and it falls. An enemy under both your banner and your Hunter's Marks takes both: they add together.

woe_of_cinders.Name: Woe of Cinders
woe_of_cinders.Description: Lay a Woe of Cinders on every enemy in an area: its Fire resistance falls by 20 and it takes 8% more Fire damage. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_rime.Name: Woe of Rime
woe_of_rime.Description: Lay a Woe of Rime on every enemy in an area: its Cold resistance falls by 20, it takes 8% more Cold damage and it moves 10% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_entropy.Name: Woe of Entropy
woe_of_entropy.Description: Lay a Woe of Entropy on every enemy in an area: it takes 20% more Chaos damage and Entropy laid on it implodes 0.5 seconds sooner. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_the_tempest.Name: Woe of the Tempest
woe_of_the_tempest.Description: Lay a Woe of the Tempest on every enemy in an area: its Lightning resistance falls by 20 and it takes 8% more Lightning damage. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_sundering.Name: Woe of Sundering
woe_of_sundering.Description: Lay a Woe of Sundering on every enemy in an area: it takes 30% more Physical damage. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_faltering.Name: Woe of Faltering
woe_of_faltering.Description: Lay a Woe of Faltering on every enemy in an area: its hits deal 20% less damage and it moves 20% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

herald_of_embers.Name: Herald of Embers
herald_of_embers.Description: Swear a Herald of fire: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra fire damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) burst into flame: 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as fire damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with your Fire and Elemental damage and the hit's own skill modifiers; the kill effect is always a share of the slain enemy's life. Skills linked to Brutality gain nothing from it.

herald_of_rime.Name: Herald of Rime
herald_of_rime.Description: Swear a Herald of cold: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra cold damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) shatter: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as cold damage within 3 metres (it chills). Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with your Cold and Elemental damage and the hit's own skill modifiers; the kill effect is always a share of the slain enemy's life. Skills linked to Brutality gain nothing from it.

herald_of_storms.Name: Herald of Storms
herald_of_storms.Description: Swear a Herald of lightning: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra lightning damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) arc to the 3 nearest enemies within 5 metres: 8% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as lightning damage. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with your Lightning and Elemental damage and the hit's own skill modifiers; the kill effect is always a share of the slain enemy's life. Skills linked to Brutality gain nothing from it.

herald_of_rot.Name: Herald of Rot
herald_of_rot.Description: Swear a Herald of poison: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra poison damage (9% at gem level 1, 17.55% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) burst into rot: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as poison damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with your Poison damage and the hit's own skill modifiers; the kill effect is always a share of the slain enemy's life.

vow_of_the_bulwark.Name: Vow of the Bulwark
vow_of_the_bulwark.Description: Swear a Vow against the elements and venom: +11.5% to fire, cold, lightning and poison resistances at gem level 1, +33.4% at 20 (never past your maximum). Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the resistances are 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.

vow_of_iron.Name: Vow of Iron
vow_of_iron.Description: Swear a Vow of iron: 28.8% more Armour at gem level 1, 50.6% at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Armour bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 126% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.

vow_of_the_wind.Name: Vow of the Wind
vow_of_the_wind.Description: Swear a Vow of the wind: 28.8% more Evasion at gem level 1, 50.6% at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the Evasion bonus is 2.5 times as strong (about 126% more at 20) for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.

vow_of_warding.Name: Vow of Warding
vow_of_warding.Description: Swear a Vow of warding: 28.8% more Energy Shield and 23% faster Energy Shield recharge at gem level 1, 50.6% more and 44.9% faster at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): both bonuses are 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it just before a Guardian's big blow.

sentence_of_chains.Name: Sentence of Chains
sentence_of_chains.Description: Sentence one enemy: it takes 16% more Physical damage, deals 25% less damage and moves 15% slower. Only one enemy can be Sentenced, by any Sentence; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain a Resolve charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (32.5% less damage dealt).

sentence_of_rot.Name: Sentence of Rot
sentence_of_rot.Description: Sentence one enemy: it takes 45% more damage from Bleed, Poison and Ignite. Damage from hits is not raised. Only one enemy can be Sentenced, by any Sentence; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (58.5% more). It adds with every other takes more damage effect, on Guardians too.

sentence_of_exposure.Name: Sentence of Exposure
sentence_of_exposure.Description: Sentence one enemy: its Fire, Cold, Lightning and Poison resistance falls by 20% and it takes 11% more Fire, Cold and Lightning damage. A Woe that lowers the same resistance adds its cut on top (a Woe and a Sentence stack). Only one enemy can be Sentenced, by any Sentence; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (-26% resistance).

vow_of_zeal.Name: Vow of Zeal
vow_of_zeal.Description: Swear a Vow of zeal: 6.9% more Attack and Cast Speed at gem level 1, 13.5% at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the bonus is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it as a Guardian opens up.

vow_of_precision.Name: Vow of Precision
vow_of_precision.Description: Swear a Vow of precision: 46% increased Critical Strike Chance and +11.5% to Critical Strike Multiplier at gem level 1, 89.7% and +22.4% at 20. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the bonus is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it as a Guardian opens up.

vow_of_judgement.Name: Vow of Judgement
vow_of_judgement.Description: Swear a Vow of judgement: your damage Penetrates 5.75% Elemental Resistances at gem level 1, 11.2% at 20. Strongest where resistances are highest: Guardians and deep Ruptures. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the bonus is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Break it as a Guardian opens up.

herald_of_steel.Name: Herald of Steel
herald_of_steel.Description: Swear the Herald of Steel: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra physical damage (9% at gem level 1, 17.55% at 20), and your kills (and your minions' and totems' kills) burst into shards of steel: 9% of the slain enemy's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as physical damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Physical damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life.

ns103_cinder_mites.Name: Cinder Mites
ns103_cinder_mites.Description: Summons 2 Cinder Mites (3 from gem level 10) that scuttle at your heels. They never fight and enemies never target them. Every 1.6 seconds each mite spits an ember at the nearest enemy within 6.5 metres: a hit of this gem's fire damage that always Ignites. Each mite within 6 metres of you grants 3% more fire damage (9% with 3 mites). Reserves 20% of your mana while one lives (7% for a Mage). Supports on this gem shape the embers; minion count supports add mites.

ns103_rime_sprites.Name: Rime Sprites
ns103_rime_sprites.Description: Summons 2 Rime Sprites (3 from gem level 10) that drift at your shoulder. They never fight and enemies never target them. Every 1.6 seconds each sprite breathes frost on every enemy within 3 metres of it: a hit of this gem's cold damage that Chills. Each sprite within 6 metres of you grants 3% more cold damage (9% with 3 sprites). Reserves 20% of your mana while one lives (7% for a Ranger). Supports on this gem shape the frost; minion count supports add sprites.

ns103_brass_sentinels.Name: Brass Sentinels
ns103_brass_sentinels.Description: Summons 2 Brass Sentinels (3 from gem level 10), small steam driven clockwork guards that march at your side. They never fight and enemies never target them. Every 1.6 seconds each sentinel arcs lightning to the nearest enemy within 6.5 metres: a hit of this gem's lightning damage that always Shocks. Each sentinel within 6 metres of you grants 3% more lightning damage (9% with 3 sentinels). Reserves 20% of your mana while one lives (7% for a Warrior). Supports on this gem shape the arcs; minion count supports add sentinels.

ns103_oath_fallen.Name: Oath of the Fallen
ns103_oath_fallen.Description: Swear an Oath of the Fallen: every 5th enemy killed within 12 metres of you rises as a spectral oathsworn at your side for 5 seconds (6.9 at gem level 20). Each spirit grants 3% increased attack and cast speed and 1% reduced damage taken. Spirits add up with no limit but their time: 10 spirits are 30% increased speed and 10% reduced damage taken. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the spirits leave you, you gain 12% more attack and cast speed for 4 seconds, then the Oath cannot be sworn for 10 seconds.

ns103_elemental_echo.Name: Elemental Echo
ns103_elemental_echo.Description: Swear an Elemental Echo: a kill leaves an echo of the killing hit's element for 4 seconds (5.9 at gem level 20), renewed by every kill of that element. Each echo grants 12% more damage of its element: fire, cold, lightning, poison or physical. Several elements echo at once, so a build that kills with two elements keeps both. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): 20% more damage for 4 seconds, then the Echo cannot be sworn for 10 seconds.

ns103_ancestral_warrior.Name: Ancestral Warrior
ns103_ancestral_warrior.Description: Raise a carved warrior statue up to 9 metres away for 10 seconds. Every 0.75 seconds it slams the ground at its feet with your weapon: an attack at this gem's damage against every enemy within 3 metres (area size widens it), so it only strikes when enemies close in. While you stand within 6 metres of it you have 10% increased attack speed. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support, the passive tree and gear add more. Slam and Melee supports on this gem change its blows. The statue has 50% of your maximum life.

ns103_horn_of_jarls.Name: Horn of the Jarls
ns103_horn_of_jarls.Description: Plant a war horn up to 9 metres away for 12 seconds. Every 4 seconds it sounds: every enemy within 6.5 metres turns on the horn for 3 seconds, and while you stand within 9.5 metres of it you gain a Resolve charge for each enemy it reached, up to 3 a call (each charge: 6% reduced physical damage taken and +6% to elemental resistances). The horn has 80% of your maximum life. Area size widens the call. One at a time; the Multiple Totems support adds more.

storm_whirl.Name: Storm Whirl
storm_whirl.Description: Hold to spin inside a crackling vortex, moving toward the cursor; lightning lashes everything around you and strikes one enemy every turn.

flame_dash.Name: Flame Dash
flame_dash.Description: Teleport a short distance toward the cursor in a burst of flame, leaving a burning path that sears enemies standing in it. Every half second the path deals half the damage shown, for 3 seconds. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

winter_orb.Name: Winter Orb
winter_orb.Description: Conjure every orb of ice you can hold (one to start, more from passives and gear) by your shoulder for 10 seconds. They hurl icicles at nearby enemies (faster with cast speed and Winter Orb fire rate), then shatter in a frost explosion that chills everything around it. At your orb limit, casting again shatters the oldest orb at once.

storm_brand.Name: Storm Spark
storm_brand.Description: Throw a crackling spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.5 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with lightning that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 sparks apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. Not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Link Cast on Crit and every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

ember_spark.Name: Ember Spark
ember_spark.Description: Throw a smouldering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.8 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with a heavy blow of fire that sets it burning. It never chains to other enemies: it is the spark for the one enemy that will not die. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 sparks apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. Not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Link Cast on Crit and every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you. Fits Trap Support: thrown as a trap, it latches onto the first enemy that sets it off.

rime_spark.Name: Rime Spark
rime_spark.Description: Throw a freezing spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.7 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with frost that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump, chilling the whole pack. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 sparks apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. Not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Link Cast on Crit and every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you. Fits Trap Support: thrown as a trap, it latches onto the first enemy that sets it off.

venom_spark.Name: Venom Spark
venom_spark.Description: Throw a festering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.4 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host and {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) with venom, a tenth less on each jump, and every strike adds a poison: the longer it crawls, the deeper they rot. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 sparks apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. Not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Link Cast on Crit and every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you. Fits Trap Support: thrown as a trap, it latches onto the first enemy that sets it off.

thunderfall.Name: Thunderfall
thunderfall.Description: Strike three times with your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a staff or wand suits it). The third blow calls lightning down on every enemy in front of you. Its damage is lightning: all of it is converted already, so a conversion support, gear or tree node shares that 100% with it instead of adding on top. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.

glacial_shards.Name: Glacial Shards
glacial_shards.Description: Flick {Projectiles} shards of ice from your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a wand or staff suits it). Each bursts into frost on the first enemy it strikes, chilling everything nearby. Its damage is cold: all of it is converted already, so a conversion support, gear or tree node shares that 100% with it instead of adding on top. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.

wayward_orb.Name: Wayward Orb
wayward_orb.Description: Loose orbs of raw power that settle over enemies. Every 0.6 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes: the orb pulses on every enemy close around its host, and after every 3 pulses it leaps to the nearest other enemy and strikes at once. When its host dies it finds another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 orbs apart (3 from gem level 20); recasts add more up to your Spark limit (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replace the oldest. With Flame, Ice, Lightning or Venom linked, most of its damage becomes fire, cold, lightning or poison and the orb wears that element. It counts as a Spark, not a projectile.

thousand_sparks.Name: Living Orb
thousand_sparks.Description: Become a living orb of fire and fly from group to group around you, bursting on every enemy near each landing. {Flights} flights (4, plus 1 at gem level 10, 1 at 20 and 1 for each Chain). The last burst hits 60% harder. You end beside the last group you hit, or at once when you click to move or roll. With Ice, Lightning or Venom linked, the orb and its bursts turn cold, lightning or poison. Cast speed quickens the flights. Counts as a Movement skill. You cannot be hit while you fly, but a cast within 1 second of the last flight ending gives no protection. Only your own cast starts it: Cast on Crit and other triggers never do.

reap.Name: Reap
reap.Description: Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide, hungry sweep that cuts everything in front of you.

death_coil.Name: Death Coil
death_coil.Description: Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a coil of grave-magic that seeks the nearest foe ahead and bursts on it, rotting everything nearby.

summon_skeletons.Name: Summon Skeletons
summon_skeletons.Description: Raise skeleton warriors from the ground: two, and one more at gem levels 8, 15 and 22 (every 7 gem levels). While you are below level 10 it raises 2 more and costs half the mana, a starter's help that ends at level 10. They follow you and fight until they fall.

summon_skeletal_mage.Name: Summon Skeletal Mage
summon_skeletal_mage.Description: Raise skeletal mages that keep their distance and hurl bolts of dark magic at your foes: one, two from gem level 13, three from gem level 25. They stay until they fall.

drain_life.Name: Drain Life
drain_life.Description: Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor with a beam of grave-hunger: it rots while you drink, and the beam forks on to 3 more enemies nearby, each link a tenth weaker. A quarter of the damage comes back to you as life, and your minions drink with you.

vampire_dash.Name: Vampire Dash
vampire_dash.Description: Come apart into mist and bats and gather again a short way toward the cursor. The mist lingers on your path and rots whatever stands in it. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

summon_bone_golem.Name: Grave Golem
summon_bone_golem.Description: Tear a golem of grave-fire out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: you regenerate 1% of your life a second near it, and the golem takes 15% of the damage of hits you take near it (never its last life point). A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.

summon_flame_golem.Name: Flame Golem
summon_flame_golem.Description: Tear a golem of living flame out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: your minions near it deal 12.5% more damage, and enemies that die near it burst into flame for 6% of their life as Fire (the burst never bursts again). A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.

summon_ice_golem.Name: Ice Golem
summon_ice_golem.Description: Tear a golem of black ice out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: you have 31% more armour near it. Enemies near it are chilled 15% and deal 8% less damage. A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.

summon_storm_golem.Name: Storm Golem
summon_storm_golem.Description: Tear a golem of caged storm out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: your and your minions' hits Shock enemies near it for 10% more damage taken (a stronger Shock wins), and your minions near it are 15% faster. A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.

summon_venom_golem.Name: Venom Golem
summon_venom_golem.Description: Tear a golem of grave-venom out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it. Supports change its damage, never its form or its blessing. Only one golem answers at a time. Use it again while the golem stands to send it leaping where you aim, once every 6 seconds. Its blessing: enemies near it take 7.5% more damage. A blessing grows with your minion damage and minion life increases: 50% of its strength with none, full strength from 100% combined. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.

summon_zombie.Name: Raise Zombie
summon_zombie.Description: Drag a zombie up out of the ground: two stand at once, three from gem level 24. Zombies stay until they fall, grow with the gem, hit hard and every fourth blow slams the ground round their foe. Supports such as Brutality or Flame make them brutal or burning.

grave_call.Name: Grave Call
grave_call.Description: Call every minion you have to your side. They come running (those far away step out of the ground beside you) and close in round you, then fight on with 30% more damage, moving and attacking 20% faster, for 4 seconds.

unholy_void.Name: Unholy Void
unholy_void.Description: Open a void of unholy energy around you: enemies inside take poison damage twice a second, 70% of the damage shown each time. The void gnaws at you too: 0.9% of your life per second, less with poison resistance, never the last tenth of your life. Press again to close it.

grave_reap.Name: Gravereap
grave_reap.Description: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Thralls that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.

soul_rend.Name: Soul Rend
soul_rend.Description: Two heavy chops tear at the soul. Enemies hit are Rent for 4 seconds: your minions deal 10% more damage to them. 30% of its damage is poison.

marrow_lance.Name: Marrow Lance
marrow_lance.Description: Hurl a lance of bone that pierces through the line. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Casters that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.

pyre_burst.Name: Pyre Burst
pyre_burst.Description: Set a fresh corpse near your aim ablaze. It bursts in fire, hitting every enemy around it, and deals 10% of the slain's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as extra fire (20% at gem level 20). Your own fallen minions count as corpses. With no corpse there, your nearest minion is sacrificed instead.

gravefeast.Name: Gravefeast
gravefeast.Description: Hold to draw every fresh corpse within 6 metres of your aim into your minions. Each corpse gives your minions one Feast for 10 seconds (refreshed by each new corpse, up to 10 Feasts, 20 at gem level 20): each Feast is 1% more damage and 0.5% more attack and cast speed for your minions. While you hold it, every corpse your skills burst within its reach also counts as consumed.

hammer_blow.Name: Hammer Blow
hammer_blow.Description: Your mace's basic attack, no mana cost. A heavy blow at the enemy in front of you.

holy_slash.Name: Holy Slash
holy_slash.Description: A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you. Your mace's mana skill; Hammer Blow is its free attack.

judgement.Name: Judgement
judgement.Description: Raise your weapon to the sky: a moment later bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another, each exploding on impact. {Projectiles} {Projectiles}|plural(one=bolt,other=bolts); one more at gem levels 10 and 20. The bolts are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them. Judgement is a Skyfall skill: every Skyfall line reaches it, and second fall lines (Twice Judged, Twice-Fallen Sky) drop the sky again where each bolt lands (each enemy takes one second fall per cast).

orbiting_hammers.Name: Orbiting Hammers
orbiting_hammers.Description: Needs a mace or hammer in your hand (Paladins call the hammers without one). Turn on a ring of {OrbitCount} spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back again, smashing everything it passes. It drains 6 mana a second while it spins (more with supports); press again to turn it off, and it stops when your mana runs out. One more hammer at gem levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20; from five hammers a second, outer ring turns the other way and pulses out as the inner one comes in. Hammerstorm empowers it.

hammerstorm.Name: Hammerstorm
hammerstorm.Description: Needs a mace or hammer in your hand (Paladins call the hammers without one). Swear the hammers to the storm: for 6 seconds your spinning hammers turn half again as fast, reach 35% farther, hit 40% harder and three more hammers join them in a second ring. If no hammers are spinning, it calls them.

consecrated_ground.Name: Consecrated Ground
consecrated_ground.Description: Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you for 5 seconds. Enemies on it burn with holy light, are slowed, take 20% more damage from every hit and are struck critically more often (+8% chance); you regenerate 2% of your life per second while you stand on it.

holy_charge.Name: Holy Charge
holy_charge.Description: Charge behind your shield toward the cursor and bash the first enemy in your path, stunning it. Where the charge ends, holy light burns the ground for 2 seconds, slowing enemies and healing you. The bash deals the full damage shown; the holy light deals 35% of it every half second. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

summon_holy_elemental.Name: Holy Elemental
summon_holy_elemental.Description: Call down a Holy Elemental of living light. It fights at your side, smashing your foes with blows of holy light that strike everything around them, until it is destroyed. A second elemental answers at gem level 10. Its light shelters you: within 9 metres of it you have +6% chance to block (never past the 75% block cap, so a build already at the cap gains nothing from it) and regenerate 0.5% of your life a second. Shared Light: past 4 elementals, each deals 4% less per extra elemental standing (12: 32% less each). The army never shrinks, only the blow each one lands.

pyre_of_faith.Name: Pyre of Faith
pyre_of_faith.Description: Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn twice a second for fire damage that grows with your maximum life. The pyre burns you too: 6% of your life per second, a quarter of that at 75% fire resistance, never the last tenth of your life: you need life regeneration. Press again to put it out. Its burn is a Fire spell hit: Fire, Spell, Area and Holy damage scale it; Burning damage modifiers scale Ignites, not the pyre. Added Fire damage to Spells adds its full value to every burn, but most of the burn comes from your life, so life is its main scaler. Maximum life here is your full life: Reserved Life counts.

hallowed_slam.Name: Hallowed Slam
hallowed_slam.Description: Bring your weapon down on the ground in front of you. Where it lands the ground is hallowed for 3 seconds, one new patch a second: enemies on it burn for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second and take 8% more damage from every hit, and you regain life while you stand in it.

shield_throw.Name: Shield Throw
shield_throw.Description: Hurl your shield at the enemy in front of you. It rings off the first enemy it strikes into the next, up to 3 more times, a little weaker at every leap. A Shield skill: while you hold a shield it gains 1% increased damage per 5 armour, evasion and energy shield on that shield, and Shield skill bonuses apply. Without a shield it keeps its full base damage.

quick_shot.Name: Quick Shot
quick_shot.Description: Loose an arrow at the target. Free to use.

power_shot.Name: Piercing Shot
power_shot.Description: Draw the bow to its full and loose a heavy arrow that pierces every enemy in its path.

split_shot.Name: Split Shot
split_shot.Description: Loose a fan of {Projectiles} arrows. Each enemy is struck by one arrow. One more arrow at gem levels 8 and 16.

arrow_rain.Name: Rain of Arrows
arrow_rain.Description: Fire a volley into the sky. A moment later it rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times. Aimed at an enemy, the volley leads it: it falls where that enemy will be when the arrows land.

wind_vault.Name: Wind Vault
wind_vault.Description: Vault toward the cursor on a gust of wind (or back, away from it, when the cursor is close), shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. The damage shown is a full hit: each landing arrow deals 60% of it and the gust 15%. Cancels attacks. The arrows are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them. You cannot be hit for the first 0.25 seconds.

lightning_arrow.Name: Lightning Arrow
lightning_arrow.Description: Loose an arrow charged with lightning. Half its physical damage is converted to lightning. When it strikes an enemy, lightning leaps from it to {Chains} more {Chains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) for 72% of the hit, a tenth less on each jump. The first enemy takes the full damage shown. With no other enemy in reach, the leaps it cannot make come back into that enemy as one extra strike, about 3% of the hit for each leap: about 29% more on a lone boss with 10 leaps.

summon_ballista.Name: Ballista
summon_ballista.Description: Plant a ballista where you aim (up to 9 metres away) that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support, the passive tree, gear and your Dragonling's Arcane Lattice add more. Bow engine: your Ballistas and Arrow Totems share one limit (7 + bonuses): past it a new one replaces your oldest, and each count past it gives every bow engine 5% more damage instead. Supports on this gem change its bolts. Each bolt pierces one enemy; with Chain or Fork linked it chains or forks at its first enemy instead.

caustic_arrow.Name: Caustic Arrow
caustic_arrow.Description: Loose a rotten arrow that bursts into a caustic cloud where it strikes, one new cloud a second. The cloud lingers for 3 seconds and poisons every enemy inside for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second. 60% of its damage is poison.

fuse_arrow.Name: Fuse Arrow
fuse_arrow.Description: Loose an arrow with a burning fuse. It bursts in fire where it strikes, hitting every enemy around the target. 60% of its damage is fire.

hoarfrost_volley.Name: Hoarfrost Volley
hoarfrost_volley.Description: Loose a close cone of {Projectiles} frost arrows. Their damage is cold and they chill what they hit. Each enemy is struck by one arrow.

twin_cuts.Name: Twin Cuts
twin_cuts.Description: Your blades' basic attack, no mana cost. A quick cut with each blade at the enemy in front of you.

flurry.Name: Flurry
flurry.Description: A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last one is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back. Your blades' mana skill; Twin Cuts is their free attack.

iaido_thrust.Name: Iaido Thrust
iaido_thrust.Description: Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line. A moment later you sheathe and they bleed for a second cut. The dash cut deals the full damage shown, the sheathe cut 38% of it. Every enemy you cut stays marked for 5 seconds, and each new cut on a marked enemy adds 25% of that cut to its mark: Sheathe makes them burst. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack. You cannot be hit for the first 0.2 seconds.

crescent_slash.Name: Crescent Slash
crescent_slash.Description: A heavy cross cut with both blades. The cut flies on as a crescent wave that slices through every enemy on its line.

shuriken_fan.Name: Shuriken Fan
shuriken_fan.Description: Flick a fan of {Projectiles} spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through {Pierce} {Pierce}|plural(one=foe,other=foes) before it stops. One more at gem levels 10 and 18.

blade_vortex.Name: Blade Vortex
blade_vortex.Description: {OrbitCount} spectral {OrbitCount}|plural(one=blade joins,other=blades join) a ring that circles you for 6 seconds, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Cast again to add more: up to {OrbitMax} blades. While it is on your bar, every basic attack that lands adds a blade.

thousand_cuts.Name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.Description: Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group around you five times, cutting everything near each one. The last cut is the heaviest. You end beside the last group you cut. Counts as a Movement skill and as a dash: movement supports, passives, items and Echo Cut apply (Echo Cut adds one more cut where you end). It is still a melee attack. You cannot be hit while you fly.

sheathe.Name: Sheathe
sheathe.Description: Sheathe your blades with a click. Every enemy your Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first, for 160% of its mark, and half of that to everything around it. A mark is the strongest Iaido cut on that enemy plus 25% of every other cut it took while marked, so thrust through it a few times before you sheathe. Needs marks: cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.

viper_fang.Name: Viper Fang
viper_fang.Description: Three quick poisoned stabs at the enemy in front of you. Most of their damage is poison, and every stab lays a stack of poison that keeps eating at the enemy after you move on.

moonfall.Name: Moonfall
moonfall.Description: Leap to the cursor and fall on the enemies there with both blades. As you sheathe them a moment later, every enemy you struck is cut again for half the damage. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

cyclone.Name: Cyclone
cyclone.Description: Hold to spin with your weapon outstretched, moving toward the cursor through enemies and cutting everything around you. Costs mana while you spin.

shield_charge.Name: Shield Charge
shield_charge.Description: Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival: the blast hits everything around you. Each enemy the blast catches gives back 1.5 mana. Almost no cooldown, chain it from pack to pack.

earthshatter.Name: Earthshatter
earthshatter.Description: Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor, hitting everything on its line. Enemies it kills leave a spike of rock that shatters a moment later, hitting those around it.

rending_slam.Name: Rending Slam
rending_slam.Description: Bring a two-handed weapon down so hard the ground rends: a shock runs out in a straight line toward the cursor, hitting every enemy on it. Your body is in the blow: 4% of your maximum life joins the weapon's base damage (Reserved Life counts). No cooldown.

wheeling_axe.Name: Wheeling Axe
wheeling_axe.Description: Hurl a spinning axe toward the cursor. It cuts through every enemy in its path, then wheels back to your hand and cuts them again on the way.

chain.Name: Chain
chain.Description: Chains 2 additional times, each time to another enemy (never the same one twice): strong in packs, adds nothing against a lone boss. Each jump hits 8% harder than the last, so a full chain hits the last enemies hardest. 5% less damage. A projectile that still pierces flies on first and chains once its pierce runs out (a Ballista bolt chains at its first enemy). A Spark's leaps are not projectiles: they gain the extra leaps, but each leap still loses a tenth of its damage.

multiple_projectiles.Name: Multiple Projectiles
multiple_projectiles.Description: Fires 2 additional projectiles in a fan. 15% less damage. Each enemy is hit by one projectile per cast; the extras hit the pack behind.

increased_area.Name: Increased Area
increased_area.Description: 50% increased area of effect (radius about 22% larger).

concentrated.Name: Concentrated Effect
concentrated.Description: 30% less area of effect. 12% more damage and 25% increased damage.

added_lightning.Name: Added Lightning
added_lightning.Description: Adds 1 to 6 lightning damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage, and +10% chance to Shock.

added_poison.Name: Added Poison
added_poison.Description: Adds 1 to 6 poison damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. The skill's poison damage penetrates 10% poison resistance. Supports Attack and Spell skills: any hit with poison damage can poison. Supported skills get -40% to Damage over Time Multiplier, added to your other multipliers. On a minion skill its minions' hits carry it at half strength.

added_fire.Name: Added Fire
added_fire.Description: Spells gain 2 to 5 fire damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage (not a summon's minions). Every skill gains 30% of its physical damage as extra fire damage: it counts the physical left after conversion, so it adds less with Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked.

elemental_focus.Name: Elemental Focus
elemental_focus.Description: 12% more and 25% increased Fire, Cold and Lightning damage on any skill (Physical and Poison gain nothing; Entropy implosions gain nothing extra), but the supported skill's Ignites deal 40% less damage. Conversion comes first: Physical that Flame, Ice or Zap converts gains it; the part Venom converts to Poison or Sanctified converts to Physical does not.

toxic_focus.Name: Toxic Focus
toxic_focus.Description: 12% more poison damage and 25% increased poison damage: poison hits and the poisons they apply. Damage converted to Poison (Venom) counts as poison too.

faster_casting.Name: Faster Casting
faster_casting.Description: 25% more cast speed. On a summon of casters (Skeletal Mage): they cast 25% faster.

faster_attacks.Name: Faster Attacks
faster_attacks.Description: 25% more attack speed. On a summon: its minions attack 25% faster.

penetration.Name: Elemental Penetration
penetration.Description: Hits ignore 20% of enemy elemental resistance.

life_leech.Name: Life Leech
life_leech.Description: 1.5% of the damage the skill deals is leeched as life, and its hits deal 15% more damage while you are leeching (below full life); its Bleed, Poison and Ignite do not.

brutality.Name: Brutality
brutality.Description: 12% more physical damage and 125% increased Physical Attack damage (minions: 10% increased physical damage). Deals no elemental damage. Linked with Lightning, Flame or Ice, the converted share is lost. Heralds of Embers, Rime and Storms add nothing to it (their extra damage is elemental); Herald of Rot still does.

pierce.Name: Pierce
pierce.Description: Projectiles pierce 2 additional targets. 10% less damage.

spell_echo.Name: Spell Echo
spell_echo.Description: The spell repeats once. 15% less damage. 10% less cast speed. On a channel it adds an echo pulse every 2nd tick at 90% of the hit. An echoed curse is 20% stronger and an echoed war cry's Resolve lasts 1 second longer. Never repeats a dash, a Vow, a toggle like Orbiting Hammers or a spell a trigger casts, and a triggered cast pays none of its price (a Spark still gains its extra spark body). Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

melee_physical.Name: Melee Physical Damage
melee_physical.Description: 12% more melee physical damage and 75% increased Physical Attack damage (minions: 10% increased physical damage). 10% less attack speed. Works on melee minions. It scales only the physical left after conversion.

controlled_destruction.Name: Controlled Destruction
controlled_destruction.Description: 15% more spell damage and 30% increased spell damage. -40% to Critical Strike Multiplier: best on spells that rarely crit.

bloodbound.Name: Bloodbound
bloodbound.Description: The linked skill costs life instead of mana (10% more cost) and deals 7% more damage, another 10% more on its hits (not its damage over time) while you are below half your life. The classic way to keep a channel running on an empty mana pool: pair it with Siphon or Vow of Vigor.

siphon.Name: Siphon
siphon.Description: 2% of the linked skill's damage is leeched as life; attacks also leech 1% as mana. A totem's hits leech at 30% of that.

tithe.Name: Tithe
tithe.Description: Every hit of the linked skill returns 2 mana plus 0.4% of your maximum mana (attacks) and every kill 6 mana plus 2% of your maximum mana (spells, attacks and the kills of a linked summon's minions). On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life the linked skill takes returns its kill mana.

woebringer.Name: Woebringer
woebringer.Description: The linked Woe becomes an aura around you: while sworn it reserves 24% of your mana and lays the Woe on every enemy within 4.5 metres, more with area size on the Woe (Dread grows while they stay in it). Link it to several Woes and each one is its own aura, up to the number of Woes an enemy can carry (2 + your extra Woes), each reserving its own 24%. Press the skill again to end it.

pass_sentence.Name: Pass Sentence
pass_sentence.Description: When the Sentenced enemy dies, the Sentence passes to the nearest rare or unique enemy (else the nearest enemy) within 10 metres.

gather_fury.Name: Gather Fury
gather_fury.Description: Kills with the linked skill grant a Fury charge (at most one every half second). Fury: 8% increased damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed per charge, 5 charges at most. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the charge. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life the linked skill takes counts as a kill.

bloodlust_support.Name: Bloodlust
bloodlust_support.Description: Melee skills only. Each kill with the linked skill grants 1 stack of Bloodlust, a melee frenzy: 0.5% increased melee damage, 0.2% increased melee attack speed and 0.1% increased movement speed for each stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the stack.

war_banner_support.Name: War Banner
war_banner_support.Description: Retired: the War Banner is now a skill gem of its own. Any War Banner support you had became the War Banner skill gem.

hunters_mark_support.Name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark_support.Description: Bow skills (the Ranger's mark) and minion skills. Each hit with the linked bow skill puts 1 Hunter's Mark on the enemy: it takes 1.7% more damage for each Mark, up to 10. The Marks fall off 3 seconds after your last hit, so keep shooting. Marks add with your War Banner, curses and every other takes more damage effect. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

unravel_support.Name: Unravel
unravel_support.Description: Spell skills only. Each hit with the linked spell adds 1 Unravel stack to the enemy for the hit's element (fire, cold or lightning, each counted on its own): it takes 0.7% more damage of that element per stack, up to 25 (17.5%). Stacks build while you keep casting and last 4 seconds after your last hit, then fall off one at a time. Unravel adds with curses, Marks and every other takes more damage effect.

woe_bearer.Name: Woe Bearer
woe_bearer.Description: The linked Woe is borne by your blows: every enemy your hits and your totems' hits strike takes it too (not your minions' hits, not spells a trigger casts for you), while it has room for another Woe (it never replaces one). The Woe can still be cast. Two Woe Bearers work at once, and one more for each extra Woe you can lay on an enemy.

totem_support.Name: Spell Totem
totem_support.Description: The spell is no longer cast by you: casting places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells can become a totem (not Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Living Orb (you fly it yourself) or any Spark). Spell Echo and other spell repeats also echo the totem's casts, each echo dealing 20% less damage (a totem's pace ignores cast speed). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's casts. Spell totem: shares the Totem limit with your other totems (11 + bonuses). 35% less damage. A Totem's Judgement strikes for 60% of your own cast. For bow skills, use Arrow Totem. With Trap also socketed, the totem still places the skill and Trap only adds its damage and cost. On a totem, Skyfall still drops Projectile and Chain spells from the sky; Orbit, Rain and Tether lose their shape (only their numbers and cost count).

arrow_totem.Name: Arrow Totem
arrow_totem.Description: The bow skill is no longer fired by you: firing places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that fires it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only bow skills that shoot arrows can become a totem (not Rain of Arrows, Wind Vault or the Ballista). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's shots, and Multiple Totems adds more totems. Bow engine: your Arrow Totems share the Ballista limit with your Ballistas (7 + bonuses), each count past it gives every bow engine 5% more damage instead. 60% less damage. With Trap also socketed, the totem still places the skill and Trap only adds its damage and cost. On a totem, Skyfall still drops its arrows from the sky; Orbit, Rain and Tether lose their shape (only their numbers and cost count).

multiple_totems.Name: Multiple Totems
multiple_totems.Description: You may have 1 additional totem or ballista of the supported skill at once, and it recovers 20% faster. Gem levels never add totems; the passive tree and items can add more. 20% less damage. All your skills together stand at most 7 bow engines (Ballistas and Arrow Totems) and 11 spell totems. Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 50% of one's damage.

bone_guard.Name: Bone Guard
bone_guard.Description: Minions from the supported skill stay close and take on what comes at you. They have 20% more life, 50% more armour and regenerate 2.5% of their life per second. While one stands within 9 metres, you have 30% more armour plus 10 armour per level, and regenerate 1% of your life per second.

ravening_host.Name: Ravening Host
ravening_host.Description: Minions from the supported skill range ahead of you and hunt, engaging enemies 50% farther away. They deal 9% more damage and 25% increased damage and move, attack and cast 15% faster.

zap_support.Name: Lightning
zap_support.Description: Turns the skill to lightning: 60% of Physical, Fire and Cold damage is converted to Lightning (Poison at half: 30%). Hits shock with 30% increased effect of Shock, and its Shocks stack: 1 more Shock can sit on an enemy (each Shock is as strong as the Lightning in its own hit: a mostly Physical hit adds only a small one). A spinning attack calls lightning down from the sky onto the enemies it cuts. (Not the Zap spell: Zap is a skill gem of its own.) Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

flame_support.Name: Flame
flame_support.Description: 60% of Physical, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Fire (Poison at half: 30%). Hits ignite. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

ice_support.Name: Ice
ice_support.Description: 60% of Physical, Fire and Lightning damage is converted to Cold (Poison at half: 30%). Hits chill; chilled kills shatter. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

venom_support.Name: Venom
venom_support.Description: 30% of Physical, Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Poison. +25% chance to Poison. Poison hits ignore 15% of Poison resistance. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 70% left physical.

skyfall.Name: Skyfall
skyfall.Description: The skill strikes from the sky at its target instead of travelling (every chain target is struck from above; a bow's arrows drop point-first). A Nova falls on its target up to 9 metres away and blooms there. Earthshatter, a Slam, takes Skyfall by name: a meteor of the slam's element falls at the end of the fissure (the one slam that can fall). Your area bonuses widen the blast where it falls. Extra projectiles fall together as one bigger strike: its area grows with each one. Only Projectile, Chain, Brand and Nova spells (every Spark), projectile attacks (not Crescent Slash's wave) and the Ballista's volley can fall; each enemy is struck once per use, and a projectile that falls takes your Skyfall damage bonuses, not your Projectile ones. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain or Tether also socketed, the gem in the earlier socket shapes it, and a Skyfall that loses adds only its Skyfall tag, so your Skyfall bonuses still count. A Trap or a Totem gem places the skill and Skyfall still works through it: its Projectile and Chain spells and arrows fall from the sky. Winter Orb and Orbiting Hammers keep circling, and Living Orb (you fly it yourself) never falls.

tether.Name: Tether
tether.Description: Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 other enemies within 5 metres for 3 seconds (at most 6 links burn at once); linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain or Skyfall also socketed, the gem in the earlier socket shapes it, and with Trap or a Totem gem the links never form.

swift_step.Name: Swift Step
swift_step.Description: The movement skill has a 40% shorter cooldown and deals 8% more damage and 15% increased damage.

channel_conduit.Name: Channel Conduit
channel_conduit.Description: While you channel, your linked spell casts itself at the nearest enemy every 0.5 seconds for half its mana cost, with this skill's other supports. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. 30% more channelling cost. Works with Cyclone and every channelled attack. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.

honed_edge.Name: Honed Edge
honed_edge.Description: +1% to base Critical Strike Chance and 80% increased Critical Strike Chance. Best on a build that already raises its critical strikes. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

deathblow.Name: Deathblow
deathblow.Description: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier: critical strikes hit much harder. Best with Honed Edge or other critical strike chance. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

orbit.Name: Orbit
orbit.Description: The skill's projectiles first circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy (a bow's arrows circle nose-first). Spells gain +1 projectile. Attacks deal 50% less damage. Not on a skill that already circles you, such as Orbiting Hammers or Winter Orb (each keeps its own ring), and not on Crescent Slash's wave. Every projectile circles, up to 24 at once. Every projectile strikes; one sent at an enemy this cast already struck deals 75% less damage (an arrow or thrown blade 90% less: spread them over a pack). A skill takes one shape: Orbit keeps it circling even with Meteor Lore (the fall gives way); with Rain, Tether or Skyfall also socketed, the gem in the earlier socket shapes it and the other keeps only its numbers and cost; with Trap or a Totem gem, that gem places the skill and Orbit only adds its numbers and cost.

channel_mastery.Name: Unbroken Channel
channel_mastery.Description: Up to 25% more damage, ramping in over the first second of channelling. 20% less channelling cost.

minion_damage.Name: Minion Damage
minion_damage.Description: Minions from the supported skill deal 12% more damage and 25% increased damage.

minion_life.Name: Minion Life
minion_life.Description: Minions from the supported skill have 25% more life and 175% increased life.

minion_speed.Name: Minion Speed
minion_speed.Description: Minions from the supported skill move, attack and cast 25% faster.

fork.Name: Fork
fork.Description: Projectiles fork into two on hitting an enemy: each flies on to either side for 70% of the hit. A projectile that still pierces forks once its pierce runs out; Shuriken Fan and melee waves fork at their first enemy and fly on, and a Ballista bolt forks at its first enemy.

rain_support.Name: Rain
rain_support.Description: The projectiles no longer fly: they go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times (four times with 4 or more projectiles). 50% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down on its target twice. Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or Crescent Slash's wave: they cannot rain. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Tether or Skyfall also socketed, the gem in the earlier socket shapes it; with Trap or a Totem gem, that gem places the skill and Rain only adds its numbers and cost (its 50% less damage too).

trap_support.Name: Trap
trap_support.Description: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds). Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash, Living Orb (you fly it yourself) or Storm Spark: they cannot be thrown. It is live the moment it lands and goes off the instant an enemy comes within 4 metres; its first strike deals 15% more damage, then it re-arms about a second later (sooner with faster re-arm). It also fits a bow Ballista. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby. 12% more damage and 25% increased damage. Your Traps out at once share their damage: each Trap past the first adds 20% of a Trap's damage. With Spell Totem or Arrow Totem also socketed, the totem places the skill and Trap only adds its damage and cost. Under a Trap, Skyfall still drops Projectile and Chain skills from the sky; Orbit, Rain and Tether lose their shape (only their numbers and cost count). Set off by Cast on Crit or another trigger, the skill casts at once instead of placing a Trap.

afterimage.Name: Afterimage
afterimage.Description: Supported melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing. 20% less damage. On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage. If your gear or tree already repeats the skill, this gem's less damage hits only its own repeats.

affliction_support.Name: Affliction
affliction_support.Description: +35% chance to Ignite and +35% chance to Poison. 50% increased Burning and Poison damage. 10% less damage with hits.

stormfrost_support.Name: Stormfrost
stormfrost_support.Description: +25% chance to Shock and 50% increased effect of Shock. Cold hits build up Freeze 60% faster, and its Lightning damage is 15% more against Chilled or Frozen enemies.

repeat_support.Name: Repeat
repeat_support.Description: Bow skills fire 1 more time, a moment later (a Ballista fires each bolt twice). Channelled skills strike 1 more time inside each pulse. 45% less damage. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage. If your gear or tree already repeats the skill, only this gem's own repeats take the full 45% less; the hit and the gear repeats take about 8% less.

cast_on_crit.Name: Cast on Crit
cast_on_crit.Description:
What it does depends on the skill it sits in.
In a spell with nothing linked: the spell casts itself at the enemy struck when one of your attacks lands a critical hit, for its full mana cost. All such spells take turns on one clock: at most one cast every 0.3 seconds.
In an attack with nothing linked: the attack strikes by itself when another of your attacks lands a critical hit. All such attacks share one clock of 0.75 seconds and deal 58% less damage in all (a Rain drops every wave, each at its share of the damage; Repeat, Afterimage and Multistrike never repeat it). Blade Vortex fills and renews its ring this way. In a channelled attack, its own critical hits release a crit pulse, its hit again around it, on that same clock.
With a spell linked (any skill that hits): its critical hits cast that spell, for its full mana cost.
Only attacks' critical hits set off the unlinked ones; a spell's critical hits cast its own link and also give the unlinked ones their turn. All your Cast on Crit share one 0.15 second clock, so one critical hit casts one skill. Triggered skills deal 25% less damage, must be on your skill bar and never trigger anything. It never spends your last 20% of mana. Only spells can be linked. Movement skills, Sheathe, channelled spells, Heralds, Vows and auras never cast or strike by themselves. In a totem or ballista it casts only its own link, at most once per second.

cast_when_hit.Name: Cast when Hit
cast_when_hit.Description: Each time you have taken damage equal to 10% of your maximum life, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the attacker, at most once every 0.5 seconds, for 50% of its mana cost. The triggered spell deals 10% less damage. In an attack, or to cast another spell, drop a spell on its link. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second.

cast_on_minion_death.Name: Cast on Minion Death
cast_on_minion_death.Description: When a minion from this skill dies, your linked spell casts itself at the enemy nearest to where it fell, at most once per second, for 50% of its mana cost and with this skill's other supports. The linked spell deals 10% less damage. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. One link per skill: the first linking support socketed works. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.

rend.Name: Rend
rend.Description: Physical hits of this skill have a 50% chance to cause Bleeding: 50% of the hit's physical damage each second for 4 seconds (the strongest bleed holds; 50% more while the enemy moves). 12% more Bleeding damage and 100% increased Bleeding damage. A new bleed on a bleeding enemy deepens it 6%, up to 6 times. A Slam or a crit cashes 50% of the next 4 seconds of bleed at once. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

deep_wounds.Name: Deep Wounds
deep_wounds.Description: +40% to Damage over Time Multiplier for this skill, added to your other multipliers: its Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal more. Hits are unchanged. A Slam or a crit cashes 50% of the next 4 seconds of bleed at once. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

living_storm.Name: Gathering Storm
living_storm.Description: This skill's Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 75% more damage taken (each Shock is as strong as the Lightning in its own hit: a mostly Physical hit adds only a small one). +25% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

contagion_flame.Name: Contagious Flame
contagion_flame.Description: When an enemy this skill ignited dies, its Ignite spreads (100% chance) to enemies within 4.5 metres. While it burns, every second it also passes its Ignite to the nearest enemy within 3 metres that burns less. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

shatter.Name: Shatter
shatter.Description: Chilled or Frozen enemies this skill kills shatter: 12% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 metres, chilling them, and an enemy the burst kills shatters in turn. 20% increased effect of Chill. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

melee_splash.Name: Melee Splash
melee_splash.Description: Every blow splashes: enemies within 2 metres of each enemy struck take 55% of the blow's damage (once per blow). 10% less damage. Works on minions: their blows splash too.

multistrike.Name: Multistrike
multistrike.Description: The melee attack strikes 3 times: it repeats 2 more times and every strike deals 44% of the damage (56% less). On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Works on minions: each of their blows strikes 2 more times. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage. If your gear or tree already repeats the skill, this gem's less damage hits only its own repeats.

maim.Name: Maim
maim.Description: Hits Maim the enemy for 4 seconds: it moves 30% slower and takes 10% more Physical damage from hits by you, your minions and your allies (not from Bleed). 8% more Physical damage. Works on minions. Only the Physical part counts: damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked) gains nothing from Maim.

ruthless.Name: Ruthless
ruthless.Description: Every third blow is a Ruthless blow: 60% more Physical damage on that hit (the Bleed or Poison it starts is not raised) and a heavy, bloody impact. Works on minions: every third blow of each minion.

executioner.Name: Executioner
executioner.Description: The physical finisher: 35% more damage against enemies below half their life on the physical part of a hit (14% on its fire, cold, lightning and poison), and hits kill enemies left below 10% of their life (Guardians too). Hits only: Bleed, Poison and Ignite do not gain the more damage. Works with bows and on minions.

vicious_projectiles.Name: Vicious Projectiles
vicious_projectiles.Description: 12% more Physical damage with projectiles and 100% increased Physical damage with projectile attacks, 10% less attack speed. Only the Physical part counts: it adds nothing to damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked). On a summon it fits minions that shoot, at half strength.

added_cold.Name: Added Cold
added_cold.Description: Adds 3 to 4 cold damage to spells and attacks, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. Steadier than Added Lightning (1 to 6) for the same average: it chills where Added Lightning shocks.

chain_detonation.Name: Chain Detonation
chain_detonation.Description: Supports skills thrown as Traps. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby, one after another. Traps set each other off at 100% increased distance, and each Trap further down the chain deals 8% more damage. +1 to the maximum number of Traps.

volatile_dead.Name: Volatile Dead
volatile_dead.Description: Minions from the supported skill explode where they fall: when killed, when their time runs out, or when a new cast replaces them past your limit. Each blast deals Fire Damage equal to 80% of its hit damage in 3 metres, wider with area of effect. Recast at your limit to detonate your oldest minions.

funeral_pyre.Name: Funeral Pyre
funeral_pyre.Description: Enemies killed by the supported skill's hits burst into flame where they fall, dealing Fire Damage in 2.5 metres equal to 15% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life). The burst is not the skill's hit, so what it kills does not burst again.

inspiration.Name: Inspiration
inspiration.Description: The linked skill costs 25% less. No damage of its own: it keeps a spammed spell or attack firing.

economical_vow.Name: Economical Vow
economical_vow.Description: The linked Vow or Herald reserves a further 10% less of your pool. Every Vow and Herald already reserves 20% less on its own (patch 82), so this gem is for the hero who wants room for one more Vow.

wide_burst.Name: Wide Burst
wide_burst.Description: The linked Herald's kill effect reaches 60% further: Embers and Rot burst over 4 metres, Rime shatters over 4.8 metres, Storms arcs to enemies within 8 metres. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.

ruinous_herald.Name: Ruinous Herald
ruinous_herald.Description: The linked Herald's kill effect deals 60% more damage (Embers 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life becomes 19.2%). Kills that chain into kills: a clear speed pick. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.

lingering_woe.Name: Lingering Woe
lingering_woe.Description: The linked Woe builds Dread 50% faster and lasts 50% longer on every enemy it touches (cast, channelled, borne by Woe Bearer or sworn with Woebringer).

dawnbringer.Name: Dawnbringer
dawnbringer.Description: Every third hit of the linked Holy attack calls a pillar of dawn on the enemy, dealing 120% of the hit as Fire Damage (at most once a second on the same enemy). For Holy Slash, Hallowed Slam, Holy Charge and Shield Throw; it stacks with the Dawnward Bulwark and Dawnmarch, each counts its own hits.

grave_conscription.Name: Grave Conscription
grave_conscription.Description: Enemies killed by the linked attack have a 25% chance to rise as one of your Zombies while you have fewer than 4 (at most once every half second). Your minion damage and life apply to them, and if you also have Raise Zombie, its minion supports do too. Any attack build can grow a small horde.

venom_bloom.Name: Venom Bloom
venom_bloom.Description: Every fourth hit of the linked Poison attack bursts in venom: enemies within 2.5 metres take 45% of the hit as Poison Damage (at most once every 0.2 seconds, each enemy at most once every 0.5 seconds). For Gravereap, Soul Rend and Marrow Lance: a pack clear for poison melee.

sanctified_support.Name: Sanctifying Light
sanctified_support.Description: Turns the linked Holy attack to holy light: 60% of its Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Physical (Poison at half: 30%), so added elemental damage from your gear feeds your Physical bonuses, and it deals 8% more Physical Damage and 15% increased Physical Damage. The Paladin's answer to Zap, Flame, Ice and Venom; pairs with Brutality.

whirling_host.Name: Whirling Host
whirling_host.Description: The linked Orbit skill adds one more blade or hammer with each cast and its ring holds one more (Blade Vortex 9 instead of 8, Orbiting Hammers 4 instead of 3), each dealing 15% less damage. A wider, fuller ring that fills faster and catches more of the pack.

conjured_pair.Name: Conjured Pair
conjured_pair.Description: The linked Orb skill keeps one more orb at a time (Winter Orb: two orbs by your shoulders, both formed by one cast), each dealing 35% less damage. Twice the icicles over twice the ground: more coverage, a little more damage in all.

rampart_strike.Name: Rampart Strike
rampart_strike.Description: The linked Shield attack deals 0.8% more damage for every 1% chance to block you have (at 50% block: 40% more, at 75%: 60% more). It adds into the same damage engine as the passive tree's lines that pay your defences. Shield Charge, Holy Charge and Shield Throw: the block you build to live now hits back.

deepened_woe.Name: Deepened Woe
deepened_woe.Description: Every line of the linked Woe is 21% stronger: the damage it makes enemies take, the resistance it lowers, the damage they deal less and its slow. The Woe's own build, for when one Woe carries the whole party.

tempered_aura.Name: Tempered Aura
tempered_aura.Description: The linked damaging aura gnaws 40% less of your life (Unholy Void 0.9% to 0.54% a second, Pyre of Faith 6% to 3.6%). Stand in the fire longer: the support for life stacking aura builds.

spreading_pyre.Name: Spreading Pyre
spreading_pyre.Description: The linked corpse skill's fire leaps on to 3 more fresh corpses, one after another, each within the burst's radius of the last. Each leap bursts for its own corpse's life at 70% of the burst before it (Pyre Burst at gem 20: 10% of the slain's life, then 7%, then 4.9%, then 3.4%). Corpses its own fire makes carry it on: a pack goes up like kindling.

defiant_roar.Name: Defiant Roar
defiant_roar.Description: The linked war cry also grants a Fury charge for each Resolve charge it grants (Jarl's Roar into 3 enemies: 3 Resolve and 3 Fury), and that Resolve lasts 50% longer (10 s to 15 s). Fury: 8% increased damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each, 5 charges at most. The roar that holds the line now pays you to stand in it.

rallying_standard.Name: Rallying Standard
rallying_standard.Description: The linked War Banner lands with 5 Valour already raised, keeps all of its Valour when you move it (not half), and holds up to 10 more (20 to 30). Each Valour is 0.5% more damage taken by enemies near it: a banner you can carry from pack to pack and plant straight into a Guardian fight.

focused_volley.Name: Focused Volley
focused_volley.Description: The linked bow skill fires 1 more arrow, and all its arrows fly on one line at your target, each with its own hit, so one enemy can take every arrow. Each arrow after the first deals 35% of the one before it (2 arrows: 100% + 35%; 4 arrows: 100% + 35% + 12% + 4%), and the skill deals 15% less damage. A Guardian killer: you give up the spread. It works on arrows you shoot yourself and on the bolts of your Ballista or Arrow Totem (not a trap or rain).

killer_instinct.Name: Killer Instinct
killer_instinct.Description: Your linked minions strike for the throat: +4% to their base critical strike chance, 100% increased critical strike chance and +40% to critical strike multiplier. The crit support minion builds never had: your tree's minion and critical strike lines now have something to scale.

ironclad_fury.Name: Ironclad Fury
ironclad_fury.Description: The linked skill deals 0.25% more damage per 1,000 Armour you have. Every 1,000 counts in full: at 40,000 Armour, 10% more. It adds into the same damage engine as the passive tree's lines that pay your defences. Any attack or spell, totems and traps too.

kindling_support.Name: Kindling
kindling_support.Description: Spells only. Each kill with the linked spell grants 1 stack of Kindling: 0.5% increased spell damage and 0.2% increased cast speed for each stack, up to 50 stacks.
