Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a Guardian, every 4% of its life the spell takes counts as a kill. Grave Call kills nothing itself, so it never gains Kindling.

fervent_vow.Name: Fervent Vow
fervent_vow.Description: Every line of the linked Vow gets another 15% of its base value while it is sworn, its Vowbreak too. Every Vow gem's own text already includes its built-in 15% (patch 82): Vow of Iron's 50.6% more Armour at gem level 20 becomes 57.2% with this gem. Heralds grow with Herald Effect instead.

arc_conduit.Name: Arc Conduit
arc_conduit.Description: When this skill hits a Shocked enemy, lightning arcs from it to the 2 nearest other Shocked enemies within 8 metres, each taking 40% of the hit. An arc never arcs again, and each enemy arcs at most twice a second. +20% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. Shock the pack with any skill and every hit of this one runs through it: a clear pick that adds nothing against a lone Guardian.

frostbreak.Name: Frostbreak
frostbreak.Description: Hits of this skill deal 50% more damage to a Brittle Guardian or boss (the 5.5 seconds after its freeze bar fills). Hits on a Chilled or Frozen enemy break off shards: 25% of the hit as Cold damage to up to 6 enemies within 3 metres (each enemy sheds shards at most twice a second). Fill the freeze bar with your cold skill, then break it with this one.

wildfire.Name: Wildfire
wildfire.Description: When this skill hits a Burning enemy, flames leap from it to the 2 nearest enemies within 5 metres that are not burning: each takes 30% of the hit as Fire damage and is always Ignited by it. Each enemy throws flames at most twice a second. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. Contagious Flame spreads Ignite when an enemy dies; Wildfire spreads it on every hit.

haemorrhage.Name: Haemorrhage
haemorrhage.Description: Hits of this skill deal 40% more damage to an enemy Bleeding from another of your skills. Its own bleeds do not count. A wound another of your skills laid counts for as long as it lasts, even when this skill's own bleed is the stronger one. Open with a bleed (Rend on the quick skill), then tear it with this one (a Slam on a deep wound). Nothing changes on enemies that do not bleed.

lone_herald.Name: Lone Herald
lone_herald.Description: The linked Herald's extra damage and its kill effect are 15% stronger for each other Herald you have not sworn. Alone it is 60% stronger: at gem level 20 its 19.5% of hit damage as extra becomes 31.2%, and Herald of Embers' burst 12% of the slain enemy's maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) becomes 19.2%. With every Herald sworn it adds nothing. The reservation the other Heralds would take is yours to spend on Vows, Woes or minions.

woeweaver.Name: Woeweaver
woeweaver.Description: Hits of this skill deal 25% more damage to an enemy that bears exactly one Woe, 10% more if it bears two, and no more with three or more. One Woe woven into your main skill instead of a ring of them: the reservation you keep is yours for Vows, Heralds or minions.

quarry_command.Name: Quarry Command
quarry_command.Description: The linked minions hunt your quarry: the last enemy you hit yourself in the last 6 seconds, within 15 metres. They turn on it and deal 30% more damage to it, and 30% less to every other enemy while you have a quarry. Strike the Guardian or the rare with your own skill and the pack follows your lead.

skyward_oath.Name: Skyward Oath
skyward_oath.Description: Critical strikes of the linked Melee attack call down 2 Sky Swords on the enemy struck, each dealing 24% of that critical hit (at most once a second). The swords fall within 2.5 metres of the enemy, are not hits of the attack and trigger nothing themselves. For any blade that crits: a clean cut, and the sky signs it.

stormhound_pact.Name: Stormhound Pact
stormhound_pact.Description: Critical strikes of the linked Lightning spell loose a Storm Wolf for 4 seconds (at most 2 wolves, at most one new wolf a second). Each wolf leaps at an enemy within 8 metres every 0.8 seconds for 16% of that critical hit as Lightning Damage. At least a quarter of the spell's hit must be Lightning, its own or converted. The wolves are not casts of the spell and trigger nothing themselves. A caster's own pack.

pale_apprentices.Name: Pale Apprentices
pale_apprentices.Description: Enemies killed by the linked spell have a 20% chance to rise as one of your Skeletal Mages while you have fewer than 3 raised this way (at most once every half second). Your minion damage and life apply to them, and if you also have Summon Skeletal Mage, its minion supports do too (Pale Apprentices links to a spell, not to Summon Skeletal Mage itself). Any caster can keep a few students.

rimewake.Name: Rimewake
rimewake.Description: The linked Movement skill ends in a burst of frost: enemies within 3 metres of the target take 25% of the skill's hit as Cold Damage (at most once every half second), and your Chill has 20% increased effect with this skill. For Leap Slam, Moonfall, Iaido Thrust, Shield Charge, Holy Charge, Wind Vault and the dashes: arrive, and the pack is already cold for Shatter.

gravesown.Name: Gravesown
gravesown.Description: While you channel the supported skill, a Husk claws up from the ground within 3 metres of you every 0.6 to 0.8 seconds (faster at higher Rupture Levels), at most 3 of your Husks at once. On a skill that is not channelled, each enemy it hits has a 10% chance to leave a Husk at its feet. A Husk is a fresh corpse for 6 seconds that your corpse skills can burst or consume. It gives no experience or loot, and triggered casts never raise one.

kindled_remains.Name: Kindled Remains
kindled_remains.Description: Each pulse of the supported channelled skill, or each hit of another supported skill (at most 4 times a second), sets off one fresh corpse within 2.5 metres of you or of the enemy struck. It bursts as the skill's damage type (Physical if none) in 2 metres for a share of the corpse's life, set per Rupture Level band so a burst keeps pace with the monsters there: 13% below RL 50, 5% at RL 50-99 (corpses there carry far more life), 54% at RL 100-149, 99% at RL 150-199 and 360% from RL 200 (corpse life stops growing at RL 150). The burst cannot crit and never sets off this support again.

chaos.Name: Chaos
chaos.Description: 40% of this skill's hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Entropy implodes 3 seconds after it is first laid as Chaos damage, 50% more, ignoring Armour and elemental Resistance. A dying enemy bursts 30% of its Entropy onto enemies within 3 metres. Entropy causes no Ailments or Leech.

entropic_focus.Name: Entropic Focus
entropic_focus.Description: Entropy this skill lays implodes for 22% more damage.

hastened_ruin.Name: Hastened Ruin
hastened_ruin.Description: Entropy this skill starts on an enemy implodes after 1.5 seconds instead of 3. Entropy this skill lays implodes for 10% less damage. Quiet Ruin has no timer to shorten.

gathering_dark.Name: Gathering Dark
gathering_dark.Description: Entropy this skill starts on an enemy implodes after 6 seconds instead of 3. Entropy this skill lays implodes for 20% more damage. Sheathe, Iaido Thrust and Grave Debt still implode it early.

cascading_ruin.Name: Cascading Ruin
cascading_ruin.Description: When an enemy dies owing this skill's Entropy, 60% of it is laid on each enemy within 3 metres instead of bursting. If one of them dies owing it, it bursts for 30% and stops. Does nothing against a lone enemy.

pact_of_ruin.Name: Pact of Ruin
pact_of_ruin.Description: This skill costs life instead of mana (30% more cost). A further 15% of its hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Entropy this skill lays implodes for 12% more damage.

lightning_n1.Name: Static Mind
lightning_n1.Text: Melee skills that deal Lightning damage hit harder.

cold_n1.Name: Frostbinder
cold_n1.Text: Projectiles that deal Cold damage hit harder.

starfall_n0.Name: Meteor Lore
starfall_n0.Text: Not on Glacial Shards, Thunderfall, Ember Spark, Drain Life or Living Orb. A socketed Skyfall gem still works on Glacial Shards.

reaper_n0.Name: Reaper's Due
reaper_n0.Text: Reaper's Communion: Your Poison Attacks hit harder for each Minion you command.

projectile_n0.Name: Fletcher's Focus
projectile_n0.Text: Enemies your Projectiles kill, your Ballistas' bolts too, burst into splinters: 10% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.

bow_n1.Name: Hoarfrost Fletching
bow_n1.Text: Cold skills land Critical Strikes more often.

evasion_n0.Name: Fleet Shadow
evasion_n0.Text: When your roll ends, the wind cuts around you: 30% of your last skill's hit to enemies within 2.5 metres (once every 2 seconds). No diminishing returns.

edge_n0.Name: Endless Edge
edge_n0.Text: Every fifth Melee hit cuts again: 20% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.

swift_n1.Name: Flash Step
swift_n1.Text: Crescent Moon: Melee skills that throw Projectiles hit harder for each extra Projectile.

mirrorblade_n0.Name: Second Shadow
mirrorblade_n0.Text: Your melee Movement skills (Shield Charge, Holy Charge, Iaido Thrust, Leap Slam, Moonfall) strike again where they land: a shadow repeats the hit, and both hits deal 20% less damage. Thousand Cuts, spell and bow dashes and channelled skills get no shadow.

mirrorblade_c1.Name: Echo Cut

stillness_n1.Name: Iaijutsu

warpath_n0.Name: Mountainhold
warpath_n0.Text: When an enemy hits you, you strike back for 40% of your skill's hit (at least 150% of the damage you took), more with your Block chance and Armour, to enemies within 3 metres (once every 0.5 seconds).

twice_fallen_sky.Name: Twice-Fallen Sky
twice_fallen_sky.Text: Every Skyfall strike falls twice: a second impact 0.4 seconds later for 20% of the damage. Other second fall sources, such as Twice Judged, Starcaller's Staff and Skyfire, add to the same impact, up to 100%.

glass_cannon.Name: Glass Cannon
glass_cannon.Text: 12% more Spell Damage and 25% increased Damage. Your minions deal 25% more Damage.

blood_magic.Name: Heartspend
blood_magic.Text: Skills cost Life instead of Mana. 30% more maximum Life.

lord_of_the_dead.Name: Marrow Lord
lord_of_the_dead.Text: +1 to the maximum number of each kind of minion.
lord_of_the_dead.Price: Your Vows, Heralds and Woes reserve 15% more mana. 6% less maximum Life.

pyre_covenant.Name: Pyre Covenant
pyre_covenant.Text: Your minions explode on death for 60% of their hit damage as Fire damage to enemies within 2.5 metres. +1 to the maximum number of each kind of minion. Your minions deal 23% increased damage.

cascade_of_ruin.Name: Cascade of Ruin
cascade_of_ruin.Price: Your hits cannot deal critical strikes.

eagle_eye.Name: Hawk's Patience
eagle_eye.Price: You cannot deal critical strikes with spells.

chain_reaction.Name: Leaping Ruin
chain_reaction.Text: Chains no longer lose damage. Your Chain skills deal 8% more damage and 15% increased damage.
chain_reaction.Price: 5% less damage to the first target hit by a Chain.

thousand_hands.Name: Thousand Hands
thousand_hands.Text: 15% more Attack Speed while Dual Wielding, and 15% more with Fists and Claws. 0.6% of Melee damage is Leeched as Life. Every eighth Melee hit releases a ring of blades: 40% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.
thousand_hands.Price: -6% to maximum Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances.

way_of_the_blade.Name: Way of the Blade
way_of_the_blade.Text: Your melee attacks repeat once. On Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang every blow repeats, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Channelled skills such as Cyclone never repeat. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

one_breath.Name: One Breath
one_breath.Text: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier. Your Attack critical strikes cut again: 25% of the hit to enemies within 2 metres (at most twice a second).
one_breath.Price: 20% less Attack Speed. Your Spells cannot deal critical strikes.

unbroken_wall.Name: Unbroken Wall
unbroken_wall.Text: +10% Chance to Block while holding a Shield. Your Attacks deal 12% more damage and 25% increased damage while you hold a Shield. When you Block, the shield strikes back: 60% of your last skill's hit as Physical damage to enemies within 2 metres (once a second).
unbroken_wall.Price: You cannot Evade and your maximum Elemental Resistances are 3% lower: the wall turns blows, not the storm.

wake_of_spells.Name: Wake of Spells
wake_of_spells.Text: All your Channelling skills are supported by Channel Conduit, which casts twice as often: your spin leaves a wake of your linked spell.
wake_of_spells.Price: Conduit spells deal 10% less damage. Channelling costs 30% more.

iron_resolve.Name: Iron Resolve
iron_resolve.Text: Armour reduces elemental hits at half value; 90% total at most.

spellblade.Name: Edgecaster
spellblade.Text: Increases and reductions to Spell damage also apply to your Attacks. 40% increased Spell damage.
spellblade.Price: Your Spells cast 10% slower. Your Attacks are not slowed.

sanctified.Name: Sanctified
sanctified.Text: Gain 25% of Physical Damage as extra Fire Damage. 60% increased Damage with Holy Spells.
sanctified.Price: 5% less Attack Damage. Your Spells have 25% increased Mana cost.

ancestral_host.Name: Ancestral Host
ancestral_host.Text: +3 to the maximum number of Ballistas and Totems. Your Ballistas and Totems have 40% increased Life. Each Totem or Ballista past the first deals 50% less damage.
ancestral_host.Price: You deal no damage with skills you use yourself (totems, minions and conduits still do).

hollow_covenant.Name: Hollow Covenant
hollow_covenant.Text: Regenerate 0.035% of Life per second for every 1% of uncapped Poison Resistance.
hollow_covenant.Price: -8% to maximum Fire and Lightning Resistances. You cannot leech Life.

siege_pact.Name: Siege Pact
siege_pact.Text: +1 to the maximum number of Ballistas and Totems. Your Ballistas and Totems fire an extra projectile. Each Totem or Ballista past the first deals 50% less damage.

forked_sky.Name: Forked Sky
forked_sky.Text: Your projectiles Fork once when they hit.

tempest_vow.Name: Tempest Vow
tempest_vow.Text: Your Channelling skills are supported by Lightning and Tether: your spin calls lightning down onto what it cuts, and every enemy it hits is linked to 2 more (the link works on Cyclone and Drain Life).

hammer_of_judgement.Name: Hammer of Judgement
hammer_of_judgement.Text: Every second Slam calls 3 Sky Swords down where it lands, each dealing 55% of the Slam's hit (once every 0.6 seconds). Your Slams deal 0.375% more damage for every 1,000 Armour you have. Adds together with your other stat engines into one more.

dawnstorm_covenant.Name: Dawnstorm Covenant
dawnstorm_covenant.Text: Your Spell critical strikes (Glacial Shards and Thunderfall count as Spells) call a pillar of dawn onto the enemy for 45% of the hit as Fire Damage (each enemy at most once a second).

choir_of_bones.Name: Choir of Bones
choir_of_bones.Text: Your Minions' Projectile skills are supported by Chain (its usual 5% less Damage, no socket, no extra Mana cost): every Skeletal Mage bolt leaps to 2 more enemies. Your Minions' Projectile skills deal 12% more Damage.

the_hunting_dead.Name: The Hunting Dead

wind_and_steel_oath.Name: Oath of Wind and Steel

Neither needs a socket or extra Mana. 15% increased Attack Speed.

earthbreaker_stride.Name: Earthbreaker Stride
earthbreaker_stride.Text: Your Movement skills (Thousand Cuts counts) end in an eruption: 5 spikes break the ground under enemies within 3.5 metres for 80% of your best skill hit of the last 4 seconds (once a second).

anvil_oath_n0.Name: Hammer and Shield
anvil_oath_n0.Text: When an enemy hits you, you strike back for 40% of your skill's hit (at least 150% of the damage you took), more with your Block chance and Armour, to enemies within 3 metres (once every 0.5 seconds).

aegis_rebuke.Name: Aegis Rebuke

comet_step.Name: Comet Step
comet_step.Text: Your roll ends in a burst of dawn fire: 260% of your last skill's hit as Fire damage to enemies within 4 metres (once every 1.5 seconds).

malediction_n0.Name: Litany of Rot

warcaller_n0.Name: Thunder of the Jarls

radiant_crusade.Name: Dawnmarch

blightword_n0.Name: Carrion Hymn
blightword_n0.Text: Pyre of Rot: Your Corpse skills hit harder the higher your chance to Poison.

rotting_gospel.Name: Rotting Gospel

r59_ignite_w_n1.Name: Forge Heat

r113_persona_warr_redrage.Text: While you are below half life, your attacks have 50% reduced Mana cost and 12% more attack speed.

r113_persona_rang_patience.Text: After you stand still for 0.8 seconds, your Bow skills (Ballistas too) deal 12% more damage until you move.

r113_persona_pala_martyr.Name: Martyr's Vow
r113_persona_pala_martyr.Text: While you are below half life, your Holy Auras (Pyre of Faith) deal 25% more damage.

r113_persona_necr_tithe.Name: Reaper's Tithe
r113_persona_necr_tithe.Text: While wielding a Scythe, your Minions have 25% increased mana Reservation Efficiency.

r113_persona_rang_wildquiver.Name: Wild Quiver
r113_persona_rang_wildquiver.Text: While wielding a Bow, your Traps and Totems (the Ballista too) have +20% chance to Poison.

r113_persona_necr_gravehunger.Name: Grave Hunger
r113_persona_necr_gravehunger.Text: Corpses your minions make stay fresh 3 seconds longer and count twice for Feast.

r113_persona_necr_lantern.Name: Charnel Court
r113_persona_necr_lantern.Text: Up to 5 corpses within 4 metres of you that died in the last 6 seconds each count as one of your minions for effects that grow with minion count. They do not fight.

r113_persona_mage_wandduel.Name: Wand Duelist
r113_persona_mage_wandduel.Text: While wielding a Wand, your Spell critical hits always Ignite, Shock, Chill or Poison by the element they deal.

r113_persona_necr_hollowcrown.Name: Hollow Crown
r113_persona_necr_hollowcrown.Text: Your Woes have 2% more effect for each minion you have (at most 20%).

r113_persona_necr_dirge.Name: Dirge of the Hold
r113_persona_necr_dirge.Text: While you channel a skill, your minions attack and cast 15% faster.

r113_persona_pala_stride.Name: Hallowed Stand
r113_persona_pala_stride.Text: After you stand still for 0.8 seconds, the ground under you becomes Hallowed for 4 seconds (2 metres): enemies on it take 10% more damage and your hits on them have +10% chance to critically strike.

r113_persona_mage_glassvigil.Name: Glass Vigil
r113_persona_mage_glassvigil.Text: While you channel a skill, hits no longer stop your Energy Shield recharge: it keeps recharging at half speed until the delay ends.

r113_persona_warr_gravefury.Name: Graveborn Fury
r113_persona_warr_gravefury.Text: While you move, a fresh corpse within 1.5 metres is consumed for a Fury charge (at most 2 a second).

r113_persona_rang_doctrine.Name: Running Doctrine
r113_persona_rang_doctrine.Text: While you move, your Hunter's Marks jump to the nearest unmarked enemy within 10 metres when the Marked one dies.

r113_persona_samu_loneblade.Name: Lone Blade
r113_persona_samu_loneblade.Text: While wielding a one-handed Sword with nothing in your off hand, +40% to Critical Strike Multiplier.

r113_persona_mage_tome.Name: Open Tome
r113_persona_mage_tome.Text: While holding a Tome, your Spells have 30% reduced Mana cost and 10% more Cast Speed.

r113_persona_pala_choir.Name: Hammer Choir
r113_persona_pala_choir.Text: Each Orbiting Hammer circling you gives Judgement 1.5% more damage (at most 9%).

r113_persona_samu_patientedge.Name: Patient Edge
r113_persona_samu_patientedge.Text: After you use Sheathe, the next 3 Attack skills you use within 5 seconds are critical hits (every hit for 0.75 seconds after each use).

r113_persona_pala_pyresaint.Name: Pyre Saint
r113_persona_pala_pyresaint.Text: Fresh corpses inside your Pyre of Faith burn out as holy fire: one every half second bursts in 2 metres for Fire damage equal to a share of its life (4% below Rupture Level 50, 2% at 50-99, 18% at 100-149, 33% at 150-199, 120% from 200).

r113_persona_samu_reedwind.Name: Reed Wind
r113_persona_samu_reedwind.Text: Each enemy your Movement skills hit gives you an Edge for 6 seconds (at most 10, Thousand Cuts counts): 2% more attack speed each.

r113_persona_mage_cadence.Name: Elemental Cadence
r113_persona_mage_cadence.Text: When you cast a Fire, Cold or Lightning spell after a spell of another element, that element counts for 4 seconds: 4% more spell damage for each element counting (up to 2).

r113_persona_warr_momentum.Name: Iron Momentum
r113_persona_warr_momentum.Text: While you channel a skill with a two-handed weapon, each metre you travel gives you 1 Momentum (at most 10): 2% more damage each. You lose all Momentum when you stop.

r113_persona_rang_falconer.Name: Falconer's Eye
r113_persona_rang_falconer.Text: Your critical hits on an enemy with a Hunter's Mark give it one more Mark.

r114_chaos_samu_quietruin.Name: Quiet Ruin
r114_chaos_samu_quietruin.Text: 20% of your Melee and Orbit hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Sheathe implodes all your Entropy within 6 metres at once as Chaos damage, 30% more. Iaido Thrust implodes the Entropy of each enemy it passes through.
r114_chaos_samu_quietruin.Price: Your Entropy never implodes on its own. It fades 8 seconds after it was last laid.

r114_chaos_necr_gravedebt.Name: Grave Debt
r114_chaos_necr_gravedebt.Text: 25% of your minions' hit damage is laid on the enemy as your Entropy instead of striking. When one of your minions dies or a corpse bursts within 4 metres of an enemy, that enemy's Entropy implodes at once as Chaos damage, 20% more.
r114_chaos_necr_gravedebt.Price: Your minions have 15% less maximum Life.

r114_chaos_pala_forsworn.Name: Forsworn Crusade
r114_chaos_pala_forsworn.Text: 25% of your Holy hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Vowbreak implodes all your Entropy within 8 metres at once as Chaos damage, 25% more.
r114_chaos_pala_forsworn.Price: After a Vowbreak your Vow stays locked 50% longer.

r114_chaos_mage_patientruin.Name: Patient Ruin
r114_chaos_mage_patientruin.Text: Your hits cannot deal critical strikes.

r114_chaos_mage_overload.Name: Entropic Overload
r114_chaos_mage_overload.Text: 30% of your Spell hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Your Spell critical strikes implode your Entropy on that enemy at once as Chaos damage, 20% more.
r114_chaos_mage_overload.Price: Your Energy Shield does not protect you from Poison and Chaos damage.

r114_chaos_necr_hungergraves.Name: Hungering Graves
r114_chaos_necr_hungergraves.Text: When one of your minions kills an enemy, your Entropy on other enemies within 3 metres of it implodes at once as Chaos damage.

r114_chaos_warr_bloodledger.Name: Blood Ledger
r114_chaos_warr_bloodledger.Text: 25% of your Melee hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. Your Slam hits implode your Entropy on each enemy they strike at once as Chaos damage, 20% more.
r114_chaos_warr_bloodledger.Price: 15% of your maximum Life is reserved.

r114_chaos_rang_ruinfletching.Name: Ruin Fletching
r114_chaos_rang_ruinfletching.Text: 20% of your Projectile hit damage is laid on the enemy as Entropy instead of striking. When an enemy reaches 10 Hunter's Marks, your Entropy on it implodes at once as Chaos damage, 25% more, and its Marks are spent.
r114_chaos_rang_ruinfletching.Price: Your Projectiles that lay Entropy do not Chain or Fork.

Mods.Text: Projectiles Pierce {v} additional Targets

windwhisper.Flavour: It gives each arrow a twin. The twin knows the way.

stormweaver_coil.Name: Stormweaver's Coil

Mods.Text: {v}% of Fire Skills' Damage Converted to Lightning Damage
Each Chain jump deals {v}% more Damage than the last

stormweaver_coil.Flavour: Lightning hands itself from one to the next, and loses nothing on the way.

ashen_crown.Name: Ashen Crown

Mods.Text: Every third Projectile skill you use makes 3 embers erupt under enemies within 4 metres, each dealing 50% of the skill's hit as Fire Damage (at most once a second)
Fire Spells have {v}% increased Area of Effect

ashen_crown.Flavour: It smoulders where the king's thoughts burned.

mountainheart.Name: Mountainheart

Mods.Text: Armour also reduces elemental hits at half value; 90% total at most

mountainheart.Flavour: Stone does not ask whether the storm is fire or ice.

oathbreaker.Name: Oathbreaker

Mods.Text: Every third Slam breaks the ground: 5 spikes erupt under enemies within 4 metres, each dealing 70% of the Slam's hit as Fire Damage (at most once every 1.2 seconds)
Oath of Embers: each second you drink no flask, 2% more damage (10% at most). A flask breaks it

oathbreaker.Flavour: Every vow ends. Most end loudly. The deep-realm smiths had a word for that sound: Carnage.

hearthfire.Name: Hearthfire

Mods.Text: Enemies you kill with Fire Spells burst into flame, hitting enemies within 2.5 metres for 35% of the killing hit as Fire Damage (at most once every 0.3 seconds)
{v}% of Lightning Skills' Damage Converted to Fire Damage

hearthfire.Flavour: Warm hands, warm home, a burned village behind.

thornhide.Name: Thornhide Wraps
thornhide.Flavour: The forest remembers who bled it.

pilgrims_stride.Name: Pilgrim's Stride
pilgrims_stride.Flavour: One more mile. Always one more mile.

eye_of_the_tempest.Name: Eye of the Tempest

Mods.Text: {v}% of Cold Skills' Damage Converted to Lightning Damage

eye_of_the_tempest.Flavour: Even the cold turns to lightning once it gets close enough.

mouth_of_the_mire.Name: Mouth of the Mire
mouth_of_the_mire.Flavour: What the marsh swallows, it keeps.

glass_soul.Name: The Glass Soul
glass_soul.Flavour: Beautiful, brilliant, and one fall from pieces.

warlords_girdle.Name: Warlord's Girdle

Mods.Text: Every third blow is Ruthless: {v}% more Physical Damage

warlords_girdle.Flavour: Tighten it and the fear goes somewhere else.

emberheart_vest.Name: Emberheart
emberheart_vest.Flavour: Carry the fire close and it carries you.

the_first_vow.Name: The First Vow

Mods.Text: Your Movement Attacks (Thousand Cuts counts) call down 3 Sky Swords within 2.5 metres of where they end, each dealing 60% of the attack's hit (at most once every 0.5 seconds)
Oath of the Unseen: each second no hit lands on you, 2% more damage (10% at most). A hit breaks it

the_first_vow.Flavour: The blade you woke with. It remembered every promise you broke since, and the sky keeps its swords for it.

squires_promise.Name: Squire's Promise

Mods.Text: Every fourth Melee hit sends out a shockwave, hitting enemies within 2.5 metres for 40% of that hit as Physical Damage (at most once every 0.5 seconds)

squires_promise.Flavour: Every oath begins with a blade held out, hilt first.

crook_of_the_vale.Name: Crook of the Vale
crook_of_the_vale.Flavour: Cut from the first birch that ever caught a storm.

wintercall_orb.Name: Wintercall Orb
wintercall_orb.Flavour: Hold it to your ear and you hear the snow falling on a world that has not ended yet.

crown_of_the_bone_king.Name: Crown of the Bone King

Mods.Text: Your Minions' damage is 60% converted to Fire
Your Skeleton Warriors from Summon Skeletons, sacrificed ones too, rise again 2 seconds after dying at no cost (at most once a second)
{v}% of your minions' hit damage is laid on the enemy as your Entropy instead of striking

crown_of_the_bone_king.Flavour: He ruled the dead the way he ruled the living: by keeping them warm. Skorch's embers are still hot.

soulreaper.Name: Soulreaper
soulreaper.Flavour: What it reaps gets up and follows.

hand_of_dawn.Name: Hand of Dawn

Mods.Text: Orbit skills deal 40% more Damage (Orbiting Hammers and Blade Vortex)
Gain 20% of Physical Damage as extra Fire Damage
When an Orbiting Hammer hits a Burning or Shocked enemy, a pillar of dawn strikes it and your Sentenced enemy for 35% of the hammer's hit as Fire Damage (each enemy at most once every 0.8 seconds)

hand_of_dawn.Flavour: At first light the hammers wake, and circle the one who still keeps the oath.

aegis_of_the_oath.Name: Aegis of the Oath
aegis_of_the_oath.Flavour: The oath was never the knight's to break. It was the armour's to keep.

the_pilgrims_pyre.Name: The Pilgrim's Pyre

the_pilgrims_pyre.Flavour: He walked into the fire to keep his word. The fire kept him.

stonefist_wraps.Name: Stonefist Wraps

siphoning_lattice.Flavour: Drink slowly. There is always more.

thrice_sworn_sash.Name: Thrice-Sworn Sash
thrice_sworn_sash.Flavour: Three knots: one for each promise you meant.

idol_rimeglass.Flavour: Ice from a pass no summer has reached, cut into a lens.

idol_engineers_gear.Name: The Engineer's Last Gear
idol_engineers_gear.Flavour: The last gear of the last engine. It turns on its own.

core_oathwardens_chain.Name: The Oathwarden's Chain

Mods.Text: 50% of Physical Damage Converted to Lightning Damage

core_oathwardens_chain.Flavour: He held the sky with it. When the oath broke, he let go.

core_link_of_the_sundered_chain.Name: Link of the Sundered Chain

Mods.Text: Your Projectiles Chain +1 time

core_link_of_the_sundered_chain.Flavour: One link of the chain that bound the sky. It pulls toward the next.

drune_falling_sky.Name: Dwarven Rune of the Falling Sky
drune_falling_sky.Flavour: Carved on the last island as it fell. The rest of the sky is on its way.

deep_forged_band.Name: Deep-Forged Band
deep_forged_band.Flavour: Hammered in the Deep Forge, where the dwarves sealed their oaths in stone.

deep_forged_torc.Name: Deep-Forged Torc
deep_forged_torc.Flavour: The forge-masters wore one rune at the throat. They said it listened.

deepwarden_lantern.Name: Deepwarden's Lantern

Mods.Text: Enemies you kill have a 30% chance to burst into lantern flame: a fire nova for 50% of the killing hit (3.5 metre radius)

deepwarden_lantern.Flavour: The wardens carried one light into the Deep. The light came back.

gravecut.Name: Gravecut

Mods.Text: Every 4th Melee hit splits the floor: bone spikes erupt under enemies around you for 80% of the hit (at most once every 0.5 seconds, 3 metre radius)

gravecut.Flavour: Forged below the last stair, where the oath was buried and the blade was not.

ossuary_stride.Name: Ossuary Stride

Mods.Text: Vampire Dash mist lingers {v}% longer
You Leech {v}% of the damage your Vampire Dash mist deals as Life

ossuary_stride.Flavour: Down there you always step on someone. These remember who.

the_unspoken_pair.Name: The Unspoken Edge

Mods.Text: Every enemy your Iaido Thrust cuts splits open: enemies within 3 metres of it take 70% of the cut as Physical Damage (at most once every 0.25 seconds, each enemy at most once every 0.5 seconds)

the_unspoken_pair.Flavour: The kensei had no names for his cuts. The dead in the Catacombs learned them anyway.

sheathbreaker_grips.Name: Sheathbreaker Grips

Mods.Text: Where your Iaido Thrust ends, the floor answers: 5 blades erupt under enemies within 3.5 metres, each dealing 60% of the cut as Physical Damage (at most once every 0.6 seconds)

sheathbreaker_grips.Flavour: Drawn, struck, sheathed. In the Deep, the third sound is the one that carries.

oathborn_crown_of_the_unbroken.Name: Crown of the Unbroken

Mods.Text: Grants Heartstopper: every 10 seconds, for 5 seconds you take 30% less damage from hits

oathborn_crown_of_the_unbroken.Flavour: Every king who wore it kept his word. There were not many.

oathborn_heart_of_the_rupture.Name: Heart of the Rupture

Mods.Text: {v}% increased Rarity of Items found for each of More Monster Life and More Monster Damage on your Rupture

oathborn_heart_of_the_rupture.Flavour: The Rupture had one heart. Someone took it.

oathborn_stride_of_the_first_oath.Name: Stride of the First Oath

Mods.Text: You cannot be slowed
Oath of the Road: each second you keep moving, 2% more damage (10% at most). Stopping breaks it

oathborn_stride_of_the_first_oath.Flavour: The first oath was a promise to keep walking.

oathborn_the_mirror_oath.Name: The Mirror Oath

Mods.Text: Repeats from gear and support gems stack at full damage

oathborn_the_mirror_oath.Flavour: Two promises, made to the same face.

oathborn_the_last_feast.Name: The Last Feast

Mods.Text: While you move, a fresh corpse within 1.5 metres is consumed for a Fury charge (at most 2 a second)

oathborn_the_last_feast.Flavour: Nothing poisons the one who ate it all.

mainspring_maul.Name: Mainspring Maul

Mods.Text: Hammerstorm lasts {v}% longer
Your hammers deal {v}% more Damage during Hammerstorm

mainspring_maul.Flavour: Wound a hundred years ago and swinging since. The gnome who wound it ran the other way.

overclock_coil.Name: Overclock Coil

Mods.Text: {v}% more Spell Damage for every 10% increased Cast Speed you have

overclock_coil.Flavour: Rated for one charge. Nobody stops at one.

cogwright_grip.Name: Cogwright's Grip

Mods.Text: Enemies you kill have a 25% chance to throw a spark loose: a lightning nova for 50% of the killing hit (3.5 metre radius)

cogwright_grip.Flavour: Brass knuckles in the most literal sense. Every finger has a gear, and every gear has an opinion.

brass_heart_locket.Name: Brass Heart Locket

Mods.Text: When your roll ends, the brass heart overpressures: a fire nova for 80% of your last skill's hit (at most once every 1.5 seconds, 3 metre radius)

brass_heart_locket.Flavour: It ticks where a heart would beat. Wearers stop noticing which one is theirs.

tickstep_treads.Name: Tickstep Treads
tickstep_treads.Flavour: Each step is exactly as long as the last. The mountain learned the rhythm and started to listen.

pinnacle_void_crown.Name: The a secret Oathword
pinnacle_void_crown.Flavour: It ate the stars one oath at a time. The last one, it wore.

pinnacle_tyrant_brand.Name: Ashbrand of the Tyrant

Mods.Text: Gain {v}% of Physical Damage as extra Fire Damage
Every third blow is Ruthless: {v}% more Physical Damage
Oath of Stillness: each second you stand still, 2% more damage (10% at most). Moving breaks it

pinnacle_tyrant_brand.Flavour: Massad burned for a year. He carried the brand that lit it.

pinnacle_regent_signet.Name: The Regent's Thirst

Mods.Text: Life Leech is doubled against the enemy you Sentenced

pinnacle_regent_signet.Flavour: Kabar paid its tithe in blood. The ring kept the ledger.

pinnacle_jarl_oathring.Name: Oath of the Last Jarl

Mods.Text: Your Warcries grant {v} Fury charge for each Resolve charge

pinnacle_jarl_oathring.Flavour: He kept his oath when the north broke theirs. It held him up.

tundra_hoarfrost_signet.Name: Hoarfrost Signet

Mods.Text: Grants Hoarfrost Shell: you take 5% less damage for each of your Orbs standing, 20% at most

tundra_hoarfrost_signet.Flavour: The desert froze the night the oath broke. The ring was on the hand that broke it.

tundra_glacier_oath.Name: The Glacier's Oath

Mods.Text: Gain {v}% of Physical Damage as extra Cold Damage
Oath of Stillness: each second you stand still, 2% more damage (10% at most). Moving breaks it

tundra_glacier_oath.Flavour: Swung once a century, the ice says. It has been a century.

tundra_rime_watch.Name: Rime of the Long Watch
tundra_rime_watch.Flavour: Four gates, one watcher. Frost on his brow, and no relief coming.

veinwrit_grips.Name: Veinwrit Grips

Mods.Text: Your Bleeds stack: up to {v} more on each enemy; each extra Bleed deals 65% less

veinwrit_grips.Flavour: No single cut is deep. There are simply too many to close.

the_red_harvest.Name: The Red Harvest

Mods.Text: Enemies that die while Bleeding from you burst for {v}% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Physical damage to enemies within 3.5 metres

the_red_harvest.Flavour: The field was reaped at dusk. Nothing in it stood up again.

dawnward_bulwark.Name: The Dawnward Bulwark

Mods.Text: Every fourth Holy melee hit calls a pillar of dawn on the enemy, dealing 60% of the hit as Fire Damage (at most once a second on the same enemy)

dawnward_bulwark.Flavour: Hold the line until the sun comes up. It always comes up.

facebreaker.Name: Facebreaker

Mods.Text: With no weapon in your main hand, your bare fists use every melee attack (Martial style)
Unarmed Attacks deal {v}% more Physical Damage

facebreaker.Flavour: Steel is a crutch. Knuckles heal harder each time.

dreadcrown.Name: Dreadcrown

Mods.Text: Your Woes build Dread {v}% faster and last {v}% longer

dreadcrown.Flavour: Three griefs on one brow, and all three land.

the_unyielding_vow.Name: The Unyielding Vow

Mods.Text: {v}% more Damage for every 1,000 Armour you have (every point counts in full)

the_unyielding_vow.Flavour: They broke the gate, the wall and the king. The vow stood there and waited for them.

the_patient_bastion.Name: The Patient Bastion

Mods.Text: {v}% more Damage for every 1% Chance to Block you have (counts up to your Block cap)

the_patient_bastion.Flavour: It remembered each blow it turned away. Then it gave them back.

the_heartwood_girdle.Name: The Heartwood Girdle

Mods.Text: {v}% more Damage for every 1,000 maximum Life you have (every point counts in full)

the_heartwood_girdle.Flavour: The older the oak, the heavier the branch.

crown_of_the_quiet_ward.Name: Crown of the Quiet Ward

Mods.Text: {v}% more Damage for every 1,000 maximum Energy Shield you have (every point counts in full)

crown_of_the_quiet_ward.Flavour: The loudest spell in the tower was cast by the mage nobody could touch.

windwrit_treads.Name: Windwrit Treads

Mods.Text: {v}% more Damage for every 1,000 Evasion you have (every point counts in full)

windwrit_treads.Flavour: The arrow arrived exactly where she had been.

the_oathkeepers_stand.Name: The Oathkeeper's Stand

Mods.Text: {v}% more Melee hit Damage for every Fortified stack you have

the_oathkeepers_stand.Flavour: Plant your feet. Each blow you land is a stone in the wall.

stormwake_treads.Name: Stormwake Treads

Mods.Text: Every 2 seconds while an enemy is within 9 metres, a free Spark leaves you and latches onto the nearest enemy that holds none of your Sparks (needs a Spark skill on your skill bar; it counts toward your Spark limit, the oldest one goes)

stormwake_treads.Flavour: Follow the crackle. That is where it went.

the_third_thunder.Name: The Third Thunder

Mods.Text: Every third strike of each Spark deals {v}% more Damage

the_third_thunder.Flavour: The first two are a warning. The third is the answer.

the_long_storm.Name: The Long Storm
the_long_storm.Flavour: Cast once at dawn. Still raining at dusk.

community_wild_trogs_thunderchord.Name: Wild Trog's Thunderchord

Mods.Text: One cast of your Spark skills throws your whole set of Sparks, and a fresh set strikes together as it lands
While all your Sparks are of one Spark skill, they strike {v}% faster
+{v} to Level of all Spark Skill Gems (Storm Brand, Wayward Orb and the Ember, Rime and Venom Sparks)

community_wild_trogs_thunderchord.Flavour: I never learned the scales. I strike every key at once.

kingbreaker_primal.Name: Kingbreaker
kingbreaker_primal.Flavour: Crowns are only metal. Metal bends.

gravesong_primal.Name: Gravesong

Mods.Text: Enemies your Poison Spells kill have a 20% chance to rise as one of your Skeletal Mages (at most 5 raised this way) (at most once every 0.5 seconds)

gravesong_primal.Flavour: It hums when something dies. The dead hum back.

gravecleaver_primal.Name: Gravecleaver

Mods.Text: Enemies you kill with Melee hits have a 25% chance to rise as one of your Zombies (at most 6 raised this way) (at most once every 0.5 seconds)

gravecleaver_primal.Flavour: Every foe it fells is a recruit.

tidebreaker_maul_primal.Name: Tidebreaker Maul

Mods.Text: Gain {v}% of Physical Damage as extra Cold Damage
Your Slams send out a tide of frost: enemies within 5 metres take 40% of the Slam's hit as Cold Damage (at most once every 0.8 seconds)

tidebreaker_maul_primal.Flavour: Forged for a giant who wanted the sea to stop. It stopped.

stormfang_primal.Name: Stormfang

Mods.Text: Your Melee critical strikes loose a storm wolf (at most 3) that leaps from enemy to enemy within 8 metres every 0.8 seconds for 4 seconds, each leap dealing 30% of the hit as Lightning Damage (at most one new wolf every 0.6 seconds)

stormfang_primal.Flavour: Lightning struck this blade and lost a tooth in it.

rimecrown_staff_primal.Name: Rimecrown
rimecrown_staff_primal.Flavour: When one of them breaks, the ones standing close break a little too.

cinderwick_primal.Name: Cinderwick

Mods.Text: +{v} to Level of all Spark Skill Gems (Storm Brand, Wayward Orb and the Ember, Rime and Venom Sparks)

cinderwick_primal.Flavour: A short fire, lit everywhere at once.

veilmothers_vestment.Name: Veilmother's Vestment
veilmothers_vestment.Flavour: The veil tears. The veil comes back.

soulsip_wraps.Name: Soulsip Wraps
soulsip_wraps.Flavour: A blow landed is a sip. I have not been thirsty in years.

weeping_talons.Name: Weeping Talons

Mods.Text: Your critical strikes always cause Bleeding

weeping_talons.Flavour: The wound stays open. The next one is already on its way.

the_pale_rake.Name: The Pale Rake
the_pale_rake.Flavour: It does not hunt to eat. It eats to hunt again.

the_quiet_verdict.Name: The Quiet Verdict

Mods.Text: Your critical strikes always Poison

the_quiet_verdict.Flavour: A small blade, a small wound, and a few quiet minutes to think about it.

jarlsbane.Name: Jarlsbane

Mods.Text: Wheeling Axe hits on the return pass always cause Bleeding, and that Bleeding deals {v}% more Damage

jarlsbane.Flavour: Raised against a jarl. Carried off by whoever was left standing.

the_fissure_edge.Name: The Fissure Edge
the_fissure_edge.Flavour: The crack runs on long after the swing has stopped.

skyrend.Name: Skyrend
skyrend.Flavour: Loosed at a falling star. It has not come down yet.

twinscar.Name: Twinscar

Mods.Text: Your Bleeds stack: up to {v} more on each enemy; each extra Bleed deals 65% less

twinscar.Flavour: One blade opens the wound. The other holds it open.

the_last_petal.Name: The Last Petal
the_last_petal.Flavour: The duel ends before the petal touches the ground.

hoarfall.Name: Hoarfall
hoarfall.Flavour: Forged for a giant's hand. The giant did not need it back.

ravenmaw.Name: Ravenmaw
ravenmaw.Flavour: The ravens follow it from field to field, and they eat well.

nightglass.Name: Nightglass
nightglass.Flavour: If you saw it in the dark, it wanted you to.

the_bellwarden.Name: The Bellwarden
the_bellwarden.Flavour: Every blow is a bell. Every bell is a warning.

the_unwritten_oath.Name: The Unwritten Oath
the_unwritten_oath.Flavour: The last page is blank. Whoever reads it aloud decides what it said.

psalter_of_the_quiet_host.Name: Psalter of the Quiet Host
psalter_of_the_quiet_host.Flavour: Its hymns were written for a choir that no longer breathes.

the_oathsplit_fang.Name: The Oathsplit Fang
the_oathsplit_fang.Flavour: One edge keeps the oath. The other speaks it.

the_last_harvest.Name: The Last Harvest
the_last_harvest.Flavour: All fields are reaped at last. This one reaps the reapers.

gravetithe.Name: Gravetithe

Mods.Text: Enemies Rent by Soul Rend take {v}% more Damage from your Minions instead of 10%
Soul Rend chops 1 additional time

gravetithe.Flavour: The grave takes its tenth. It is not patient about it.

thornwake.Name: Thornwake

Mods.Text: Enemies that die while Bleeding from you burst for {v}% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Physical damage to enemies within 3.5 metres

thornwake.Flavour: What bleeds out on its arrows goes loudly, and takes the next rank along.

oathbleeder.Name: Oathbleeder

Mods.Text: Life Leech is doubled against Bleeding enemies

oathbleeder.Flavour: The oath was broken with these. They have bled since.

cinderknuckle.Name: Cinderknuckle

Mods.Text: {v}% of Physical Damage Converted to Fire Damage

cinderknuckle.Flavour: Knuckles of banked coal. A punch is all the bellows they need.

rimewrit.Name: Rimewrit
rimewrit.Flavour: Every oath is written twice. Once in ink, once in frost.

oathborn_grasp_of_the_sworn.Name: Grasp of the Sworn

Mods.Text: Your kills grant a Fury charge (at most 2 a second)

oathborn_grasp_of_the_sworn.Flavour: The hand that took the oath has been steady since.

oathborn_the_keepers_ember.Name: The Keeper's Ember

Mods.Text: Your Woes are {v}% stronger for each of your living minions (20% at most)

oathborn_the_keepers_ember.Flavour: It keeps the dead standing, and the dead keep it burning.

the_long_battery.Name: The Long Battery

Mods.Text: Ballistas and Totems deal {v}% more Damage for each Ballista or Totem you have

the_long_battery.Flavour: One more engine on the line, and the line does not break.

warwrights_seal.Name: Warwright's Seal
warwrights_seal.Flavour: Pressed into the wax of every order that ended a siege.

vigil_of_the_last_flame.Name: Vigil of the Last Flame
vigil_of_the_last_flame.Flavour: The others slept. One knight fed the fire, and the fire held the dark back.

the_motley_court.Name: The Motley Court
the_motley_court.Flavour: Bone, flame and grave soil. No two bow the same way, and all of them bow.

the_slow_verdict.Name: The Slow Verdict
the_slow_verdict.Flavour: The blow was only the reading of the charge.

the_hangmans_patience.Name: The Hangman's Patience

Mods.Text: Your Sentence passes to the nearest rare or unique enemy when its target dies

the_hangmans_patience.Flavour: The rope is in no hurry. Neither is he.

templars_troth.Name: Templar's Troth
templars_troth.Flavour: He swore three vows at the altar. The ring holds him to a fourth.

the_oath_unspoken.Name: The Oath Unspoken
the_oath_unspoken.Flavour: Every oath in the world was broken. This one was never spoken.

quarrybreaker_gauntlets.Name: Quarrybreaker Fists

Mods.Text: Your Slams send out +{v} more wave

quarrybreaker_gauntlets.Flavour: One blow for the stone. One more to be sure.

tearmongers_greaves.Name: Tearmonger's Greaves

Mods.Text: Your Bleeding deals {v}% more Damage on moving enemies

tearmongers_greaves.Flavour: A wound opened is a promise kept.

jarls_roarhelm.Name: Jarl's Roarhelm

Mods.Text: Your Warcries grant {v} Fury charge for each Resolve charge
Resolve from your Warcries lasts {v}% longer

jarls_roarhelm.Flavour: The jarl took the blow on his shield and answered with his whole chest.

stormglass_circlet.Name: Stormglass Circlet

Mods.Text: When a Shocked enemy dies, its Shock has a {v}% chance to leap to nearby enemies

stormglass_circlet.Flavour: Lightning strikes twice when it likes the spot.

wildfire_coil.Name: Wildfire Coil

Mods.Text: When an Ignited enemy dies, its Ignite has a {v}% chance to spread to nearby enemies

wildfire_coil.Flavour: One spark in a dry field is all the argument fire needs.

hoarfrost_reliquary.Name: Hoarfrost Reliquary

Mods.Text: +{v} Winter Orb

hoarfrost_reliquary.Flavour: Winter wrote its own book. You found a page.

thunderhide_quiver.Name: Thunderhide Quiver

Mods.Text: Caustic Arrow clouds last {v}% longer
Caustic Arrow clouds drift toward the nearest enemy

thunderhide_quiver.Flavour: Stitched from a hide the storm wore first.

adders_kiss.Name: Adder's Kiss

Mods.Text: When a Poisoned enemy dies, up to {v} of its Poisons move on to a nearby enemy

adders_kiss.Flavour: When the bitten die, the venom moves on.

siegewatch_hood.Name: Siegewatch Hood
siegewatch_hood.Flavour: Set the bolts. Walk away. Let the wall do the talking.

windstep_tabi.Name: Windstep Tabi

Mods.Text: Your Movement Skills strike 1 additional time

windstep_tabi.Flavour: Where you were, you still are. For a heartbeat.

snarewrights_sash.Name: Snarewright's Sash
snarewrights_sash.Flavour: Three knots for the trap, one for the trapper.

hollow_moon_signet.Name: Hollow Moon Signet

Mods.Text: Bow Attacks fire +{v} more arrow

hollow_moon_signet.Flavour: Two arrows leave the string. Only one was aimed.

hammerbearers_reliquary.Name: Hammerbearer's Relic

Mods.Text: +{v} orbiting projectile per cast (Blade Vortex, Orbiting Hammers and the Orbit support)

hammerbearers_reliquary.Flavour: One more hammer for the choir.

pyrewardens_mantle.Name: Pyrewarden's Mantle

Mods.Text: Your Ignites stack: +{v} more on each enemy

pyrewardens_mantle.Flavour: The pyre is a prayer that answers itself.

dawnwall_bulwark.Name: Dawnwall Bulwark

Mods.Text: When you Block, sunfire bursts for 150% of your hit around you (3 metre radius)

dawnwall_bulwark.Flavour: The sun rises on whoever is still standing.

frostcaller_lantern.Name: Frostcaller Lantern

Mods.Text: +{v} to the maximum number of Skeletal Mages
Your Minions' damage is {v}% converted to Cold

frostcaller_lantern.Flavour: Light it and the dead remember the cold.

grave_psalter.Name: Grave Psalter

Mods.Text: Pyre Burst leaps on to {v} more fresh corpses

grave_psalter.Flavour: Read it aloud and the room gets smaller.

the_red_carousel.Name: The Red Carousel

Mods.Text: Every sixth hit of your Channelled Melee attacks flings a ring of blades: enemies within 3 metres take 50% of that hit as Physical Damage (at most once every 0.5 seconds)

the_red_carousel.Flavour: It turns, and everyone near it gets a ride.

rotmothers_cradle.Name: Rotmother's Cradle

Mods.Text: Your Minions' damage is {v}% converted to Poison

rotmothers_cradle.Flavour: She rocked them until they stopped breathing. Then she kept rocking, and they got up.

the_penitent_knuckle.Name: The Penitent Knuckle

Mods.Text: Every third hit of your Slams calls a pillar of dawn on the enemy, dealing 30% of that hit as Fire Damage (each enemy at most once a second)

the_penitent_knuckle.Flavour: He broke his hand on the chapel floor asking to be forgiven. The floor answered first.

vigil_of_the_storm_saint.Name: Vigil of the Storm Saint

Mods.Text: When you Block, the storm answers: enemies within 3 metres take 45% of your last skill's hit as Lightning Damage (at most once every 0.6 seconds)

vigil_of_the_storm_saint.Flavour: She stood in the gate through the whole storm. By morning the storm was standing with her.

the_dervish_ossuary.Name: The Dervish Ossuary

Mods.Text: Your Skeleton Warriors within 2.5 metres of an enemy spin as cyclones, hitting all around them for 20% of their own hit (at most once a second)

the_dervish_ossuary.Flavour: Bury a dancer standing up and the dance goes on without the skin.

the_falling_feather.Name: The Falling Feather

Mods.Text: Fuse Arrow bursts again 0.5 seconds later for {v}% of its damage

the_falling_feather.Flavour: The hawk is gone. Its feathers still come down, point first.

u200_tithe_of_the_red_furrow.Name: Tithe of the Red Furrow

Mods.Text: Your Bleeds on enemies you Sentenced have +{v}% to Damage over Time Multiplier

u200_tithe_of_the_red_furrow.Flavour: The field took a tenth of every man who crossed it. It was never the same tenth.

u200_rampart_of_embers.Name: Rampart of Embers

Mods.Text: {v}% of Physical Skills' Damage Converted to Fire Damage
Your Ignites stack: +{v} more on each enemy
Blocking grants a Fury charge (at most once a second)

u200_rampart_of_embers.Flavour: The wall burned for nine days. On the tenth they carried it into battle.

u200_thunder_anvil_greaves.Name: Thunder-Anvil Greaves

Mods.Text: {v}% of Physical Slam Skills' Damage Converted to Lightning Damage
Killing a Shocked enemy with a Slam grants a Fury charge (at most 2 a second)

u200_thunder_anvil_greaves.Flavour: Each step is a hammer blow. The storm counts them.

u200_rotfang_cleaver.Name: Rotfang Cleaver

Mods.Text: Your hits lay the Woes on your skill bar on the enemies they strike, as a Woe Bearer does

u200_rotfang_cleaver.Flavour: The butcher stopped washing it. The meat stopped needing salt.

u200_tempest_hex_ring.Name: Tempest Hex Ring

Mods.Text: Your Woes build Dread {v}% faster and last {v}% longer

u200_tempest_hex_ring.Flavour: A curse spoken in a storm travels farther than the one who spoke it.

u200_crimson_petal_blades.Name: Crimson Petal Blades

Mods.Text: Your Bleeds stack: up to {v} more on each enemy; each extra Bleed deals 65% less
Once a second, your hit on an enemy you Sentenced is a Critical Strike

u200_crimson_petal_blades.Flavour: In the east they say a duel is over when the blossoms stop falling.

u200_gale_edge_wakizashi.Name: Gale-Edge Wakizashi

Mods.Text: Crescent Slash waves Fork 1 time
Grants Mistwalker: a critical strike makes you Elusive for 2 seconds (20% less damage taken from hits, 15% increased movement speed)

u200_gale_edge_wakizashi.Flavour: Draw it into the wind and the wind draws too.

u200_the_woeweaver_s_grasp.Name: The Woeweaver's Grasp
u200_the_woeweaver_s_grasp.Flavour: Two threads in one hand. Neither pulled as tight as it could be.

u200_the_mana_ward_signet.Name: The Mana-Ward Signet

Mods.Text: Oath of Stillness: each second you stand still, 3% less damage taken (15% at most). Moving breaks it

u200_the_mana_ward_signet.Flavour: The mind is a wall. Pay the mason.

u200_frostgrave_maul.Name: Frostgrave Maul

Mods.Text: {v}% of Physical Slam Skills' Damage Converted to Cold Damage
Killing a Frozen enemy grants a Fury charge (at most 2 a second)

u200_frostgrave_maul.Flavour: Where it falls, winter is buried standing up.

u200_judicator_s_gavel.Name: Judicator's Gavel

Mods.Text: Your Judgement critical strikes fall a second time: enemies within 3 metres take 50% of the hit as Physical Damage (at most once every 0.5 seconds)
While no enemy is Sentenced by you, your Judgement critical strikes Sentence the enemy they hit

u200_judicator_s_gavel.Flavour: The first blow is the verdict. The second is the sentence.

u200_the_radiant_wheel.Name: The Radiant Wheel

Mods.Text: Your Holy Slash critical strikes throw a ring of light: enemies within 3 metres take 40% of the hit as Physical Damage (at most once every 0.3 seconds)

u200_the_radiant_wheel.Flavour: One turn for each oath kept.

u200_firebrand_codex.Name: Firebrand Codex

runewords.Flavour: The dead sing the hymns the living forgot.

runewords.Flavour: Steel that learns to sing holds the tune.

runewords.Flavour: The cloud does not ask where the lightning goes.

runewords.Name: Nightshade

runewords.Name: Heartseeker

runewords.Flavour: The blade turns in the air like a swallow, and cuts on the way back.

runewords.Name: Rimebinder
runewords.Flavour: Frost waits where you will stand.

runewords.Name: Bloodletter
runewords.Flavour: A shallow cut, and then another.

runewords.Name: Emberwake

runewords.Name: Stormlash
runewords.Flavour: The first strike finds you. The second was waiting.

runewords.Flavour: One arrow, and time.

runewords.Flavour: The learned dead still know their lessons, and teach them coldly.

idolRecipes.Name: Idol Merging
idolRecipes.Result: 1 idol of 3 cells (1x3 or 3x1); it keeps the FIRST idol's first line at the bigger size (value rolled again in its tier), its other line is new (the 3 idols and the jewel are used up)

idolRecipes.Name: Idol Fusing
idolRecipes.Recipe: 3 magic 2-cell idols + a jewel of Cut or finer
idolRecipes.Result: 1 idol of 4 cells (1x4 or 4x1); it keeps the FIRST idol's first line at the bigger size (value rolled again in its tier), its other line is new (the 3 idols and the jewel are used up)

idolRecipes.Name: Idol Tempering
idolRecipes.Recipe: a magic or rare idol + 1 Tier III or IV rune
idolRecipes.Result: the same idol: every line keeps its kind, its tier and value are rolled again within the idol's item level (it can be worse)

idolRecipes.Name: Idol Turning
idolRecipes.Recipe: a magic or rare idol of 2 to 4 cells + 1 Tier I or II rune
idolRecipes.Result: the same idol turned on its side (1x3 becomes 3x1, and back): every line, its tier and its roll kept

idolRecipes.Name: Idol Mending
idolRecipes.Recipe: a rare idol + 1 Tier III or IV rune + 1 jewel of Cut or finer + 2 Core Embers (from your Forge store)
idolRecipes.Result: the same idol: its weakest line melts and a new line of the same kind pours in; every other line stays

idolRecipes.Name: Idol Resist Turning
idolRecipes.Recipe: a magic or rare idol with a resistance line + 2 runes of Tier I to IV + 1 Core Ember (from your Forge store)
idolRecipes.Result: its resistance line turns to the next element the idol lacks, in the order Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison, Fire: same tier, same roll. Turn it again to reach the one you want

idolRecipes.Name: Idol Binding
idolRecipes.Recipe: 2 magic or rare idols of the same size, put in the one you keep FIRST (Gloomsilver from your Forge store and gold are taken)
idolRecipes.Result: the first idol takes the finest line of the second that it has room for, tier and roll kept; the second idol is used up. Costs 1 Gloomsilver and 5,000 gold per item level for each line the first idol then holds
